Desc.SourceString:
【异象故事】

「用绑架替代邀约的宴会，注定只能迎来违心的客人。」

关于异象C-1704，通称「过期请柬」的诞生来由有许多传说，以下是最广为流传的一个：

很久很久以前，一位富商即将走到生命的尽头。他回顾自己的一生：财富如山，荣誉无数，膝下虽无子嗣，进出却始终被人簇拥。富商十分满意：「我这一生已无遗憾。」
就在这时，窗外突然传来阵阵欢笑声。他勉力坐起，透过巨大的落地窗向外张望：原来是街对面的一户人家正举行家庭宴会。孩童们嬉笑着追逐打闹，玩累了便趴在长辈膝上讨糖。餐桌上的菜肴并不丰盛，但摇曳的烛火看上去是那么温暖而明亮……此刻富商置身的空旷卧室里，水晶吊灯的光芒是多么冰冷啊！
富商的宴会厅也曾挤满了人，但没有任何一场宴会如此温情。每一盏酒杯都盛着眼睛看不见的利益，在杯沿轻轻碰响时交换。对，富商想：我要举办一场「真正的宴会」。
于是，他便命人发出无数封请柬。隔天，富商强撑着下了病榻，换上宽松的晚礼服，让管家推着自己来到宴会厅。推开门，他的眼前空无一人。
富商不愿相信自己或许并不像想象中那样受人爱戴。当夜，他辗转反侧，在心中许诺：明天若是有人来到我的宴会，我就将自己的宅邸、花园、金库全部开放，让他们任意挑选自己喜欢的礼物。
仍无人到来。
第二夜，富商又想：明天若是有人来到我的宴会，我就将自己的财产全部分给他们。
仍无人到来。
第三夜，富商又想：明天若是有人来到我的宴会，我将尽我所能，实现他们所有看似不可能的愿望。
仍无人到来。

时间逐渐流逝，富商的病情在孤寂中日益沉重。终于，他再没力气起床。听见死亡的足音临近，懊丧、愤怒与怨恨在他失去温度的身体里翻涌膨胀。在黎明到来前的最后一息，富商诅咒道：谁再拆开我的请柬，就永远别想从我的「宴会」上离开。


这则传说的真伪，在我记录下这篇档案时，仍无从而知。我们所能确定的只是：富商临终前的诅咒，或许是人类历史上最具杀伤力的「诅咒」之一——以至于人们在将其作为脏话引用时，也不免心生忌惮。
如今，纵使四季如春的庭院早已荒芜，富丽堂皇的宅邸也假手他人，那些过期的请柬仍旧代行着富商的诅咒。它们看似只是一枚硕大的金色火漆，除了尺寸外毫无异样。可一旦有人不慎触碰，便会被迫成为「过期请柬」的受邀者，「造访」由瓦楞纸板搭建而成的昏黄庭院。
折叠于请柬中的「瓦楞城堡」兢兢业业地憎恨着每一位迟来的「客人」，当好奇的客人们向它走来，它便一面展开不怀好意、试图吞噬一切的红毯，一面架起用于守城战役的武器。后知后觉的客人们仓皇逃跑，勉强躲过一劫。宣告宴会结束的钟声本该是它的奇点所在，但仿佛为了惩罚这些迟来的客人，它自己总也姗姗来迟。除此之外，除非将整个异象暴力泯除，否则无人能妨碍它愚弄下一位被强行邀请的过路人。
近年来，在「环」组织和异象猎人们的共同努力下，「过期请柬」的数量已大幅减少，但街头巷尾或许还存在一些漏网之鱼。由于其总数无法统计，我们也无法知道这场旷日持久的报复将会持续到何时——也不知道，如果某个角落里另有一位主人对拒绝赴宴的客人心怀怨怼，是否会有新的「请柬」诞生。
或许，这些「请柬」的诞生方式或许从未被真正理解。一个流传已久的故事，可能只是为了延续自身而被不断讲述。越是研究，我便越感到人类对异象知之甚少。
不过，至少有一点确凿无疑——散步的时候，记得注意脚下。

【异象特性】

·外观是一枚体积较大的金色火漆，通常出现在平整的地面上。
·直接接触火漆痕迹的人类，会被卷入立体书样式的异象空间，强行参加「过期的宴会」。
·看似充满童话色彩的异象空间，实则对闯入的来客充满敌意。一旦进入，必定会遭到「瓦楞城堡」和「瓦楞红毯」的袭击。
·存在数量不详，散布地点不详，异象触发后的持续时间不详。「客人」脱离异象空间后，异象空间会重新折叠为火漆的模样。异象可以被数次重复触发。
·异象泯除后，火漆会自行燃烧殆尽，在原地留下一个宝箱——这或许是原本准备分发给宾客的伴手礼。

【异象奇点】

宣告「宴会结束」的钟声

【风险评估】

激活前：稳定；激活后：对进入异象空间的人类有很强的攻击性。

【收容/担保情况】

塞拉伊诺馆长期收容5件。

【收容措施】

无需特殊措施，只需确保其被收容在普通人无法接触、能够避免异象被意外触发的环境。

【实验记录】

实验①
派遣一位实验人员携带足量补给进入「过期请柬」的「宴会空间」，观测该异象自然泯除所需要的时间。
119小时后，出于对实验人员身心耐受程度的考虑，实验终止。「过期请柬」始终没有自然泯除的迹象。

实验②
实验人员携带多种计时装置进入「宴会空间」，在不同时段播放铃声并播报「宴会结束」，以观察异象空间的反应。
「过期请柬」对所有声音均无响应。初步判断，客观的时间变化和外部宣告均无法促使「过期请柬」泯除。

【衍生异象】

/
Desc.LocalizedString:
Anomaly Story

"A banquet that abducts but not invites is destined to welcome only reluctant guests."

There are many legends about the origin of Anomaly C-1704, commonly known as the "Expired Invitation." The following is the most widely circulated:

Long, long ago, as a wealthy merchant was nearing the end of his life, he reflected on his years: mountains of wealth, countless honors, and though he had no children, he was always surrounded by people wherever he went. The merchant was quite satisfied. "I have no regrets in this life," he thought.
Just then, laughter drifted in from outside his enormous floor-to-ceiling window. He struggled to sit up and peered through, spotting a family was holding a party across the street. Children chased each other, laughing and playing. When they grew tired, they climbed onto their elders' laps to beg for sweets. The dishes on the table were modest, but the flickering candlelight looked so warm and bright… Meanwhile, in the vast bedroom where the merchant lay, how cold the light from the crystal chandelier seemed!
The merchant's banquet hall had once been packed with guests, but none of those gatherings had ever felt so warm. Every wine glass held invisible interests, exchanged with each gentle clink of the rim. Yes, the merchant thought: I want to hold a "true banquet."
And so, he ordered countless invitations to be sent out. The next day, the merchant forced himself out of his sickbed, changed into a loose evening suit, and had his Butler wheel him to the banquet hall. But when he opened the doors, not a soul was in attendance…
The merchant refused to believe that perhaps he was not as beloved as he had imagined. That night, he tossed and turned, making a silent promise: If anyone comes to my banquet tomorrow, I will open my mansion, my gardens, and my treasury to them, and let them choose any gift they should so desire.
Still, not one soul came.
On the second night, the merchant thought: If anyone comes to my banquet tomorrow, I will give them my most precious thing… my wealth!
Still, no one came.
On the third night, the merchant thought: If anyone comes to my banquet tomorrow, I will do everything in my power to grant all their seemingly impossible wishes!
Still, the halls were empty.

Time passed, and the merchant's illness worsened in his solitude. At last, he no longer had the strength to rise from bed. Hearing the footsteps of death's approach, he felt regret, rage, and resentment churn and swell within his cooling body. With his final breath before dawn, the merchant uttered a curse: Whoever opens my invitation shall never leave my "banquet."


The truth of this legend remains unknown as I record this profile. What we can confirm is this: the merchant's dying curse may be one of the most destructive "curses" in human history, so much so that even when people use it as a swear, they cannot help but feel a twinge of dread.
Now, although the gardens of eternal spring have long fallen to ruin and the magnificent mansion has changed hands, those expired invitations still bear the merchant's curse. They appear to be nothing more than an oversized golden wax seal, unremarkable aside from their size… but the moment someone accidentally touches one, they are forced to become an "invitee" of the Expired Invitation and "visit" a dim courtyard constructed entirely of cardboard.
The cardboard castle folded within the invitation dutifully despises every guest, unfurling a malicious red carpet eager to devour all that approach, simultaneously raising weapons fit for a siege. The tardy guests flee in panic, barely escaping with their lives. The bell announcing the end of the banquet should be its Nexus, but as if to punish these late arrivals, it too is always fashionably late. Beyond that, unless the entire Anomaly is violently subjected to nullification, nothing can stop it from toying with the next passerby who is forcibly invited.
In recent years, thanks to the joint efforts of the Circle and Anomaly Hunters, the quantity of Expired Invitations has been greatly reduced. However, some may still lurk in streets and alleyways… Since the total number cannot be determined, we have no way of knowing how long this prolonged vengeance will continue, nor whether new invitations might be born should another host somewhere harbor similar resentments toward guests who refused to attend.
Perhaps the way these invitations come into being has never been truly understood. A long-told story may simply be repeated to perpetuate itself. The more I study, the more I realize how little humanity knows about anomalies.
However, at least one thing is certain: when you go for a walk, remember to watch your step.

Anomaly Characteristics

· Appears as a large golden wax seal, typically found on flat ground.
· Humans who directly touch the wax seal are drawn into a pop-up book-style Anomalous Realm, forced to attend an "expired banquet."
· The seemingly fairytale-like Anomalous Realm is actually hostile toward intruders. Once inside, visitors will certainly be attacked by the cardboard castle and the cardboard red carpet.
· The total quantity is unknown, the locations are unknown, and the duration after triggering is unknown. After a guest escapes the Anomalous Realm, it folds back into the form of a wax seal. The Anomaly can be triggered multiples.
· After nullification, the wax seal burns itself out completely, leaving behind a treasure chest in its place. This is perhaps the party favor originally prepared for guests.

Anomaly Nexus

The bell announcing "the end of the banquet"

Risk Assessment

Before Activation: Stable. After Activation: Highly aggressive toward humans who enter the Anomalous Realm.

Containment/Guarantee Status

5 specimens in long-term containment at Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures

No special measures required. Simply ensure containment in an environment where ordinary people cannot make contact and the Anomaly cannot be accidentally triggered.

Experiment Records

Experiment 1
Dispatched one test subject with sufficient supplies into the Expired Invitation's space to observe the time required for the Anomaly to naturally undergo nullification.
After 119 hours, the experiment was terminated out of concern for the test subject's physical and mental endurance. The Expired Invitation showed zero signs of natural nullification.

Experiment 2
Test subject entered the space carrying multiple timing devices, playing bell sounds and announcing "the banquet is over" at different intervals to observe the Anomalous Realm's response.
The Expired Invitation did not respond to any of the sounds. Preliminary assessment: objective changes in and external announcements cannot trigger nullification of the Expired Invitation.

Derivative Anomaly

/

Desc.SourceString:
「Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet！」

【异象故事】
你仔细在自己书桌的抽屉深处搜索，陈年故纸之中也许会有一个笔记本，它有着深色的封皮（大概率是廉价的合成革），装饰着莫名其妙的符号或者格言，翻开泛黄的纸页后，里面记录着一些关于青春期幻想的迷思，一些绝对不能被别人看见的羞耻咒语之类的。人们在十几岁的时候可能有过那么一个时期，觉得自己是与众不同的、背负使命的天选之子，但是又因为别扭的心思无法将这一点公之于众，只能夜里挑灯，对着笔记本倾诉心扉。
……如果你知道我说的这种感觉，那异象「黑之书」的形象你大概也了然于心了。

C-7111[Ob]黑之书，通常外观为一本黑色封皮的书本，正中央生有一颗紫色的眼睛。据说，黑之书中记载着高深的咒语，可以让人施展「魔法」。实际上，黑之书中记载的，大多是一些莫名其妙的青春期语录，念诵这些所谓的「咒语」没有任何意义。然而，黑之书能让人使用魔法的说法却不能说全是谣传……这要从黑之书的能力说起了。
黑之书会吸取「信仰」的力量——越是相信黑之书「具有力量」，黑之书的力量就会越强大。更加坚定的信仰，会给黑之书提供更强大的力量，而黑之书又会反过来将这份力量赋予信徒：在信徒念诵了黑之书上的咒语后，就能够泯除一些低阶异象，但实际上泯除异象的不是念咒的人，而是黑之书本身。黑之书越强大，它能够泯除的对象也越强。
在初次使用了黑之书记载的咒语后，黑之书的另一能力会逐渐显现，它会对信徒施加「精神暗示」，信徒会将自己对黑之书的信仰视作真理，为了寻求更强大的力量，吸引更多的人信仰黑之书——最终，这个最初的信徒将成为一个黑之书传播信仰的傀儡。而受到影响，开始信仰黑之书的人，同样会被施加这种盲信，但并不会取得黑之书的力量。另外，黑之书有时也会运用能力奴役、控制低级异象，为自身服务。
在黑之书被非信徒翻开时，会生成异象空间「书库」，将翻书者拉入其中直面黑之书的真身。其外观是一个黑色人形，原本的书构成了这个人形的头部，周围则是扭曲的肢体。驱动其行为的似乎是「对不信者的愤怒」，它会尝试消灭这些进入书库的人。战斗中，黑之书会使用各种类似魔法的手段——例如凭空出现的锁链、火焰和光束，这些大多来自于信徒对其力量的想象。此外，黑之书使用自身肢体发动的近身攻击同样不容小觑。
当黑之书被泯除后，其施加的精神影响会一同消失。根据目前的观察，没有发现后遗症。然而，如果长期信仰黑之书，对人的精神是否会产生永久性的扭曲，甚至造成侵凌，都尚未可知——这种影响人信念的异象，毫无疑问是最危险和恶劣的类型。

相信自己是独一无二的，这很好。但是，独一无二并不意味着拥有什么过人之处，也无需追求什么强大的力量。平凡而独特……这听起来好像是什么心灵鸡汤。然而，如果在「独特」和「强大」之间画上等号，那就会走上一条枯燥且永无止尽的道路。黑之书利用了人——更确切地说，年轻人——在对自我的认知上的迷茫，加以欺骗，可以说防不胜防。希望大家都能明白，我们不必是强大的、不必是天才、不必拥有异能，也是对他人而言不可替代的独一个体。

【异象特性】
·外观为黑色书本，本体则是头部是书本的扭曲人形物体；
·能吸收「信仰」的力量壮大自身，对信仰自身的信徒施加精神暗示；
·能够泯除或控制低等级异象；
·书中记载的内容大多是各种因青春期幻想产生的语句，没有实际意义。

【异象奇点】
信徒的信仰被动摇。在异象空间中压制并战胜黑之书，可以显著削弱其对信徒的精神影响。

【风险评估】
高危害性。由于该异象的能力隐蔽、涉及精神暗示，且传播能力和成长能力强，对社会的潜在危害极大。如果再次发现，应第一时间将其泯除。

【收容/担保情况】
唯一已知个体已泯除。

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet!"

Anomaly Story
Deep into your desk drawer, you might find a notebook buried among old papers. It probably has a dark cover (most likely cheap synthetic leather), decorated with cryptic symbols or pretentious quotes. Flip through the yellowed pages, and you'll find records of adolescent fantasies, embarrassing incantations you would never want anyone else to see. Most people go through a phase in their teens when they believe they are unique, a chosen one burdened with a special destiny, but they are too self-conscious to tell anyone… and so they stay up late at night, pouring their hearts out to a notebook.
…If you know what I'm talking about, then you probably already have a good idea of what the Anomaly known as the "Black Tome" looks like.

C-7111(Ob) Black Tome typically appears as a book with a black cover, and a piercing purple eye in the center. Legend has it that the Black Tome contains powerful spells that allow one to cast "magic." In reality, most of what's written inside is nonsensical teenage rambling, and reciting these so-called "incantations" does nothing at all. However, the claim that the Black Tome can grant magical powers isn't entirely false… which brings us to its abilities.
The Black Tome thrives off the power of belief. The more someone believes the Black Tome has powers, the more powerful it actually becomes. Stronger faith grants greater power to the Black Tome, and in turn, this power flows back to its believers: after reciting the incantations written in the Black Tome, believers can achieve nullification of some low threat anomalies. However, it is not the person reciting the spell who nullifies the Anomaly, but the Black Tome itself. The stronger the Black Tome becomes, the more powerful the targets it can nullify.
After first using an incantation from the Black Tome, another ability gradually manifests. It applies mental suggestion to users, causing them to treat their faith in the Black Tome as absolute truth. In pursuit of greater power, they are compelled to attract more people to believe in the Black Tome, eventually becoming a puppet with the sole purpose of spreading the Black Tome's faith. Those influenced and converted to believing in the Black Tome are also subjected to this blind faith, but do not gain the Black Tome's power. Additionally, the Black Tome sometimes uses its abilities to enslave and control low threat anomalies to serve itself.
When the Black Tome is opened by a non-believer, it generates an Anomalous Realm called the "Library," pulling the reader inside to face the Black Tome's true form. Its appearance within is a black humanoid figure, with the original book forming the head, surrounded by twisted limbs. Its behavior seems driven by wrath against non-believers, and it attempts to eliminate anyone who enters the Library. In battle, the Black Tome employs various magic-like methods, such as chains, flames, and beams appearing out of thin air, mostly stemming from believers' imagination of its power. Additionally, the Black Tome's close-range attacks using its own limbs should not be underestimated.
When the Black Tome is nullified, its mental influence disappears along with it. Based on current observations, no lingering aftereffects have been found. However, whether long-term belief in the Black Tome can cause permanent psychological distortion or even encroachment remains unknown. Anomalies that manipulate minds are undoubtedly among the most dangerous and insidious types.

Believing you are unique is a good thing, but being unique does not mean possessing extraordinary abilities, nor does it require pursuing great power. Ordinary yet unique… that probably sounds like something from a self-help book. However, if you equate "unique" with "powerful," you will embark on a tedious and endless path. The Black Tome exploits the confusion that people, especially young people, experience in understanding themselves, deceiving them in ways that are nearly impossible to guard against. I hope everyone can understand: we don't need to be powerful, we don't need to be geniuses, we don't need Esper Abilities to be irreplaceable individuals to those around us.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a black book. Its true form is a twisted humanoid object with a book for a head.
· Can absorb the power of "belief" to strengthen itself and apply mental suggestion to its believers.
· Can nullify or control low threat anomalies.
· The contents recorded in the book are mostly phrases born from adolescent fantasy and have no practical meaning.

Anomaly Nexus
The faith of believers is shaken. Suppressing and defeating the Black Tome within the Anomalous Realm can significantly weaken its mental influence on believers.

Risk Assessment
High hazard. Due to its inherent covertness, involvement of mental suggestion, and strong capacity for spreading and growth, it poses extreme potential danger to society. If discovered, it should be nullified immediately.

Containment/Guarantee Status
The only known specimen has been nullified.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
「他会继续欢笑。」

【异象故事】
有一名远近闻名的小丑演员拉尔，有他参加的演出都座无虚席，人们总是被他滑稽的表演和妙语连珠的笑话打动，笑得前仰后合。然而，在这位演员的隐退演出结束后，他就被发现在后台休息室死去，他安静地坐在椅子上，就像是睡着了。他的小丑面具融化成一滩黑色的液体，而他真正的面容上没有滑稽的笑容，只是一张疲惫、苍白、上了年纪的男人脸庞。后续调查中得知，他的生活充满了诸多不如意，以至于他早已厌倦了活下去，但他还是坚持着演出，观众的笑容是他苦闷生活中唯一的良药。那张融化的小丑面具，则成为了最早的异象「拉尔」——这个名字是为了纪念那位演员。

N-0502[Ob]拉尔，一种偶尔可以在喜剧演出后台发现的异象，外观是一滩黑色的粘稠液体，且每一滩拉尔的总量都恰好是502毫升。拉尔可以被装在任意可以容纳它的封闭容器中，但为了避免意外，建议使用至少1升容量的容器。收容拉尔时需要戴上手套，避免皮肤直接接触。在接触人的皮肤后，拉尔会从接触点攀爬、覆盖在接触者身上，看起来有点吓人。这个过程是无害的，但使用者可能会感到皮肤有轻微的紧绷感。在拉尔完成覆盖后，使用者可以通过脑海中的想象，调整自己的面容、声音，甚至改变自身体型和身体特征——我们强烈建议使用一面镜子作为辅助，不要顶着一张吓死人的脸出门。在大约2小时后，使用者表皮上覆盖的拉尔会逐渐脱落并恢复成液体状态，使用者的伪装也会随之消失。
一部分使用者声称，使用拉尔会对精神造成潜移默化的影响——使用者会产生表演型性格、哗众取宠、冒险和不可控行为等异常倾向，羞耻心也会有所降低。无法证明这些影响是拉尔造成的，但我们仍然略微提高了拉尔的潜在危害性，并关注长期使用的影响。

笑一个吧。就算是虚假的笑容，也是治愈心灵的良药。

【异象特性】
·外观为一滩502毫升的黑色粘稠液体，可以装在任何容器中。
·接触使用者皮肤后会形成覆盖体表的薄膜，使用者可以调整自己的面貌和体型特征。
·在使用约2小时后逐渐脱落，伪装随之消失。

【异象奇点】
被完全没有烦恼，或完全没有快乐的人使用。前者使用时，拉尔会蒸发飘散；后者使用时，拉尔会化作细沙坠落，并在不久后消失。不论哪一种，都不会对使用者造成伤害。

【风险评估】
无害。

【收容/担保情况】
大部分被塞拉伊诺馆收容，允许担保，民间有少量流通。

【收容措施】
不使用时，装在任意容量大于1升的密闭容器中。偶尔给它晒晒太阳能让它的阴暗感少一点，但这并非必要。

【实验记录】
《异象「拉尔」的潜在精神影响研究》
实验1：给一名社交障碍患者使用拉尔，让她以自己心仪的形象参加社交活动。
实验结论：拉尔不会提升使用者的社交能力。

实验2：让一名没有表演经验的普通人使用拉尔，并参加舞台剧表演。
实验结论：拉尔不会提升使用者的表演能力。

实验3：让一名特工使用拉尔后对长期暗恋却不敢表白的对象袒露心声。
实验结论：拉尔不会让一个性格内向阴暗的人变得阳光开朗，一点都不会。
备注：我真得好好管管你们滥用无害异象的毛病了。你们三个，明天到我办公室来一趟。

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"He will keep on laughing."

Anomaly Story
There was once a famous clown named Lar. Every show he appeared in was packed to the rafters, and audiences were always moved by his hilarious performances and witty jokes, laughing until they doubled over. However, after his final performance before retirement, he was found dead in the backstage dressing room. He sat quietly in his chair, as if he had simply fallen asleep. His mask had melted into a pool of black liquid, and his true face bore no comical smile, only the tired, pale features of an aging man… A subsequent investigation revealed that his life had been filled with countless misfortunes, so much so that he had long grown weary of living. Yet he persisted in performing, for the smiles of his audience were the only remedy for his bitter existence. That melted mask became the first Anomaly known as "Lar," a name given in memory of that performer.

N-0502(Ob) Lar is an Anomaly occasionally found backstage at comedy venues. It appears as a pool of viscous black liquid, with every instance of Lar measures exactly 502 milliliters. Lar can be stored in any sealed container that can hold it, though to avoid accidents, containers of at least 1 liter capacity are recommended. Gloves should be worn when handling Lar to avoid direct skin contact. Upon contact with human skin, Lar will climb from the point of contact and spread across the user's body, which can look somewhat alarming, though the process is harmless. Users may feel a slight tightness on their skin, but once Lar has fully covered the user, they can adjust their appearance, voice, and even alter their body shape and physical features through mental visualization. We strongly recommend using a mirror as an aid. Please do not go outside with a terrifying face. After approximately 2 hours, the Lar covering the user's skin will gradually peel off and return to its liquid state, and the disguise will disappear along with it.
Some users claim that using Lar has a subtle influence on the mind. Users may develop tendencies toward theatrical personalities, attention-seeking behavior, risk-taking, and uncontrollable actions, along with a reduced sense of shame. There is no proof that these effects are caused by Lar, but we have slightly raised its potential hazard rating and are monitoring the effects of long-term use.

Smile! Even a fake smile can be medicine for the soul.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a pool of 502 milliliters of viscous black liquid. Can be stored in any container.
· Forms a thin film covering the user's body upon skin contact. The user can adjust their appearance and body features.
· Gradually peels off after approximately 2 hours of use, and the disguise disappears.

Anomaly Nexus
Comes in contact with someone who has absolutely no worries, or someone who has absolutely no happiness. When used by the former, Lar evaporates and disperses. When used by the latter, Lar crumbles into fine sand and soon disappears. Neither outcome causes harm to the user.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Most specimens are contained at Celaeno Compound. Guarantees are permitted. A small number circulate among the public.

Containment Measures
When not in use, store in any sealed container with a capacity over 1 liter. Letting it bask in the sun occasionally can make it seem less gloomy, but this is not necessary.

Experiment Records
Research on the Potential Psychological Effects of the Anomaly Lar
Experiment 1: A patient with social anxiety was given Lar to use, allowing her to attend social events in an appearance she preferred.
Conclusion: Lar does not improve the user's social skills.

Experiment 2: An ordinary person with no acting experience was given Lar to use and participated in a stage play.
Conclusion: Lar does not improve the user's acting ability.

Experiment 3: An agent used Lar before confessing their feelings to someone they had secretly admired for a long time but never had the courage to approach.
Conclusion: Lar will not turn an introverted and gloomy person into someone bright and cheerful. Not one bit.
Note: I really need to do something about your habit of misusing safe anomalies. You three, come to my office tomorrow.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
「笑一个，保持住别动……别动！别眨眼！」

【异象故事】
N-0683[Ob]，一般称为「起司」的异象，偶尔出现在摄影器材密集的地方，例如器材商店、影视剧片场或大型漫展，会混在普通的摄影器材中，把自己伪装成普通的相机。当眼前出现心仪的景象时，起司就会自行进行拍摄——咔嚓！然后，取景范围内的一切都会陷入「静止」，动弹不得。这种静止现象在人身上的效果因人而异，从几分钟到几十分钟不等，但从静止状态恢复过来的人除了对静止期间的事情毫无印象外，似乎并没有其他异样。而此时，起司已经带着它拍下的照片心满意足地泯除了。
如果你发现了一台相机的真身是起司，那么你可以自称是一名「摄影师」，这样就可以让起司拍下你想要拍下的东西。它们在拍摄时不会将摄影师纳入相框，但是如果拍下的相片全都无法让它们满意，它们就会回过头来让摄影师静止，然后才会自行泯除。

【异象特性】
·外观类似普通的照相机。
·拍摄时，在镜头前一定范围内的事物会陷入「静止」状态。
·静止状态持续时间因人而异，短则几分钟，长则数十分钟，对异能者的影响相对较轻。
·对起司自称为「摄影师」，可以控制起司拍摄的内容。

【异象奇点】
拍下满意的照片后泯除。

【风险评估】
低危害性。

【收容/担保情况】
塞拉伊诺馆有一定量收容，允许民间担保。

【收容措施】
收容在暗室中，确保其镜头的取景范围一片漆黑。

【实验记录】
《关于异象「起司」静止效果持续时间的研究》
实验1：让同一人在不同环境中，接受起司的拍摄。
实验结论：静止时间有较大差异。

实验2：在相同环境中，用起司拍摄不同的人。
实验结论：静止时间有较大差异。

实验3：在相同环境中，用不同的起司对同一人进行拍摄。
实验结论：静止时间有较大差异。
备注：够了，我不会再上当了！你们根本不是为了研究，是想用起司拍我，趁我被定身的时候在我脸上画鬼脸是不是！

【衍生异象】
/

【延展信息】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Smile, hold still… Don't move! Don't blink!"

Anomaly Story
N-0683(Ob), commonly known as "Cheese," is an Anomaly that occasionally appears in places with a high concentration of photography equipment, such as camera shops, film sets, or large conventions. It blends in with ordinary photography gear, posing as a camera. When a scene catches its fancy, Cheese takes a photo on its own. Click! Then, everything within the frame falls into a state of stasis, unable to move. The duration of this effect varies from person to person, ranging from a few minutes to several dozen minutes. However, those who recover from the stasis seem to have no memory of what happened during that, and show no other abnormalities. By then, Cheese has already undergone nullification, satisfied with the photo it captured.
If you discover a camera that turns out to be Cheese, you can call yourself a "Photographer," which allows you to direct Cheese to capture what you want. Cheese will not include the Photographer in the frame when shooting, however, if none of the photos turn out to its satisfaction, it will turn around and freeze the Photographer before undergoing nullification on its own.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears similar to an ordinary camera.
· When taking a photo, everything within a certain range in front of the lens enters a state of stasis.
· The duration of stasis varies by individual, ranging from a few minutes to several dozen minutes. The effect on Espers is relatively weaker.
· Claiming to be a "Photographer" to Cheese allows control over what Cheese photographs.

Anomaly Nexus
Undergoes nullification after capturing a satisfying photo.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Celaeno Compound has a certain quantity in containment. Public guarantees are permitted.

Containment Measures
Contain in a darkroom, ensuring the lens' field of view is completely dark.

Experiment Records
Research on the Duration of the Stasis Effect of the Anomaly Cheese
Experiment 1: Have the same person photographed by Cheese in different environments.
Conclusion: Significant variation in stasis duration.

Experiment 2: Photograph different people with Cheese in the same environment.
Conclusion: Significant variation in stasis duration.

Experiment 3: Photograph the same person with different instances of Cheese in the same environment.
Conclusion: Significant variation in stasis duration.
Note: That's it. I'm not falling for this again. You're not doing this for research at all. You're just trying to draw on my face while I'm frozen.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/

Desc.SourceString:
「回不去的旧校舍，再一次出现在你的眼前。」

【异象故事】
要是教学楼能神秘失踪就好了，这样不用开学了！相信许多人在学生时代曾做过这样的白日梦吧？万一……这不仅是白日梦呢？
不少克莱门学园第■■■届学生还记得开学那天，大家拖着不情愿的步伐来到校门前，却被眼前景象惊掉了眼镜下巴和书包：宏伟漂亮的教学楼不翼而飞，原址只剩一个规模惊人的巨坑——内设有图书馆的教学楼「D」号楼神秘消失了。
近期人们发现，异象「赤门」后连接着的神秘校舍，房间布置陈设与竟与「D」号楼大致相同。据曾造访那里的异象猎人称，他在教室中摸到了儿时写了一半又撕了一半的假期作业。因此可以肯定：赤门后的空间就是克莱门学园失踪的教学楼。不过那里再无书声琅琅，只有扬尘轻轻落地之声。
教学楼为何消失，为何「赤门」又连接着我们的世界与这座校舍？这些疑问目前仍是未解之谜。但有这么一个说法似乎得到了绝大多数克莱门毕业生的肯定：它因我们对学生时代的追忆与怀念而再度现世。只是那里是仅供回忆与参观之所，再也回不去了。无论你有多么想留在那里，都无法阻止眼前的校舍空间渐渐瓦解，崩塌，消失。直到一切再度化为虚无，仿佛不曾存在过。
也有人说红色的「赤门」有着极强的隐喻意，红色之后的空间才是真正的「现实」。具体可详见影视作品《■■■■》。此说法并无事实依据论证，笔者在此仅作整理备注。

那天偷懒没擦的黑板，刻意被「忘」在抽屉里的不及格试卷，写有许多青春期少男少女心事的小纸条……你们还记得吗？


【异象特性】
·该异象是一扇颜色过于鲜亮明丽的红色的门，通常出现于一堵由垃圾桶、自动贩卖机等常见设施组成的「墙」上。墙的组成物件通常取决于发生地点附近的杂物，包括且不限于垃圾桶、废弃家具、井盖等物品。
·「赤门」呈开启状，与「赤门」相连的内部异象空间与海特洛市克莱门学园失踪教学楼「D」号楼极为相似。也有人称该空间就是「D」号楼。
·目前尚未掌握「赤门」出现的具体时间、地点规律。

【异象奇点】
「赤门」本身。握住门把手后即可离开异象空间。

【风险评估】
异象空间内有少量伴生异象活动，具有一定的攻击性。

【收容/担保情况】
无法被收容。

【收容措施】
未处于收容状态。

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/

【延展信息】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"The old school building you thought you'd never return to appears before you once more."

Anomaly Story
If only the school building could mysteriously vanish, then there would be no need for school to start! Surely many of us had such daydreams during our student days. But… what if this was more than just a daydream?
Many students from Clement Academy's Class of ■■■ still remember that day at the start of the semester. Everyone dragged their reluctant feet to the school gates, only to have their jaws drop at the sight before them: their grand and beautiful school building had vanished without a trace! There was nothing but a massive crater of staggering proportions in its wake… The entirety of Building D, which housed the library, had mysteriously vanished into thin air.
Recently, it was discovered that the mysterious school building connected through the Anomaly known as the Red Door bears a striking resemblance to Building D in its layout and furnishings. According to an Anomaly Hunter who visited the site, he found homework from his childhood in one of the classrooms, half finished and half torn up. This confirms that the space beyond the Red Door is indeed Clement Academy's missing school building. However, the halls no longer echo with the sounds of students reading aloud… Only the gentle sound of dust settling can be heard.
Why did the school building disappear? Why does the Red Door connect our world to this building? These questions remain unsolved mysteries, but one theory seems to have gained widespread acceptance among graduates: the building returned to this world because of our longing and nostalgia for our school days. Despite this, it exists only as a place for reminiscence and visitation, never to be truly used as it once was. No matter how much you wish to stay, you cannot stop the space from gradually crumbling, collapsing, and ultimately vanishing before your eyes. Inevitably, everything dissolves into nothingness once more, as if it never truly existed.
Some say the red color of the Red Door carries strong metaphorical meaning, and that the space beyond the red is the true reality. For details, see the film ■■■■. This theory has no factual basis, and is noted here only for reference.

The blackboard you were too lazy to erase that day. The failed test you deliberately "forgot" in your desk drawer. The little notes filled with the secrets of teenage boys and girls… Do you still remember?


Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly is a door of an unusually bright and vivid red color. It typically appears on a wall composed of common objects such as trash cans, vending machines, and similar fixtures. The objects forming the wall usually depend on the miscellaneous items near the location where it manifests, including but not limited to trash cans, abandoned furniture, manhole covers, and other items.
· The Red Door appears in an open state. The Anomalous Realm connected to the Red Door bears a strong resemblance to the missing Building D of Clement Academy in Hethereau. Some claim this space is Building D itself.
· The specific and location patterns governing the appearance of the Red Door have not yet been determined.

Anomaly Nexus
The Red Door itself. Grasping the door handle allows one to leave the Anomalous Realm.

Risk Assessment
There is minor Surge Anomaly activity within the Anomalous Realm, which exhibits aggression.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Cannot be contained.

Containment Measures
Not in containment.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/

Desc.SourceString:
「杀死大海的武器。」

【异象故事】
总有人说，捕鲸叉是人类向大海挑衅的武器，将巨神般的生物当作猎场中惊慌的野猪般猎杀。R-1851-1[Ob]裴廓德，或许就是人类征服大海的意志化身，其中有进取心和勇气，也不乏贪婪和傲慢。其外观是一支常见的捕鲸叉的巨大化版本，上面遍布血迹和锈痕。它插在异象海囚的背部，除了给海囚带来痛苦外，没有发现其他特殊之处。

在早年间，出于工业上的需要，捕鲸活动曾经十分活跃，而直到今天，这样的捕猎也未消失。渔叉手在捕鲸船上倍受尊敬，因为他们是捕鲸能否成功的关键，他们乘坐小艇靠近体型百倍于他们的巨兽，用手中的渔叉刺入其身躯放血，随后以绳索作为联系，开始漫长的追猎。一些捕鲸人会在此过程中死去，死于风浪，死于巨兽的挣扎，又或是死于多喝了三五口朗姆酒，但大多数时候，鲸鱼总是熬不过人类的。这些巨兽被吊起，身躯被分解，无用的皮肉被洒向大海成为食肉鱼的盛宴，而脂肪则被投入锅中熬煮鲸油，直到熬干后，再被投入炉膛用作燃料。到最后，留下的只有浓稠的油脂和洁白的骨骼。
从一些水手的记述中我们得以知晓，这套「流程」会在船上留下浓郁的腥臭和焦糊味，宛如来自地狱的味道，捕鲸叉大概就是是来自地狱的武器了。那些海中巨兽濒死时的歌声是如此哀伤……如此震撼人心。过去工业发展的需要和自然环境之间的冲突，孰是孰非，难以论断。但如今，当我们不再需要献祭它们血肉充作工业的燃料，希望这些海洋生灵不会再因单纯的贪婪和愚昧而成为牺牲品。

【异象特性】
·对异象海囚造成巨大的痛苦，并激发其攻击性。

【异象奇点】
与海囚一同泯除。

【风险评估】
低危害性，但在其刺激下，海囚会体现出更强的攻击性。

【收容/担保情况】
未收容，不可担保。

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/

【延展信息】

Desc.LocalizedString:
"A weapon to kill the sea."

Anomaly Story
Some say the harpoon is humanity's weapon of defiance against the sea. It is used to hunt majestic creatures like panicked boars in a common hunting ground. R-1851-1(Ob) Pequod may well be the very embodiment of humanity's will to conquer the sea, encompassing ambition and courage, but also greed and arrogance alike. It appears as a massively oversized version of a common whaling harpoon, covered in bloodstains and rust, lodged in the back of the Anomaly Sea Prisoner. Aside from causing the Sea Prisoner immense pain, no other special properties have been observed.

In earlier times, whaling was a thriving industry driven by commercial demand. Even today, such hunts are still ongoing, though not commonplace. Harpooners were highly respected aboard whaling ships, considering that they were the key to a successful hunt. They would approach beasts a hundred times their size in small boats, drive harpoons into their flesh to draw blood, then begin the long chase, tethered by a simple rope. Some whalers died in this process, claimed by storms, by the thrashing of the great beasts, or perhaps by three too many swigs of rum… But most of the time, the whales lacked the tenacity to outlast the humans. These giants would be hoisted up and dismantled. Useless flesh would be cast into the sea as a feast for scavenger fish, while the blubber was rendered in pots until dry and fed into furnaces as fuel. In the end, only thick oil and white bones remained.
From the accounts of some sailors, we know this "process" left a thick stench of blood and burning on the ship, like the smell of hell itself. It follows that the harpoon must be a weapon from hell, then. The dying songs of those ocean giants were so sorrowful… so profoundly moving… The conflict between the demands of industrial development in the past and the natural world is difficult to judge as right or wrong, but now that we no longer need to sacrifice their flesh as fuel for industry, may these creatures of the sea never again become victims of mere greed and ignorance…

Anomaly Characteristics
· Causes immense pain to the Anomaly Sea Prisoner and provokes its aggression.

Anomaly Nexus
Undergoes nullification together with the Sea Prisoner.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. However, under its stimulation, the Sea Prisoner exhibits heightened aggression.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not contained. Guarantee not permitted.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly

Desc.SourceString:
【异象故事】
「长明灯」是随电灯的发明出现的异象，由废弃的灯泡转变而来。
在最早的记录中，长明灯的外形与现在大不相同，只是普通的小型电灯泡。其特殊之处在于它不需要电力供给，也能一直发光。研究表明，长明灯偷取了其他灯泡的电力。其周围一公里范围内，所有其他灯泡的亮度都会降低。
随着科技发展，新型电灯取代了老式灯泡，长明灯也逐渐完成了「进化」：不再只偷取灯的电力，而是选择偷取所有电力；其外形也变得庞大而富有攻击性。
长明灯的生存压力促使其进化，新时代充足的电力则为其进化提供了能源。在这样恰当的条件下，长明灯完成了从普通灯泡到如今形态的转变。看来异象并非在诞生后就一成不变，还有可能跟随时代变迁。

【异象特性】
该异象常在夜间小巷中群体出现。当其出现时，周围区域会完全停电，并伴以弥漫的黑色雾气，致使整个街区陷入黑暗之中，严重影响周围居民的生活。
同时，其偷取行为会导致供电设施的电路板损坏。为自己充满电后，该异象会进入饱食状态并逐步增强力量，需求的电力也会越来越多。
该异象似乎格外吝惜自己储存的电力，每次攻击都严格控制电力使用量。如果从外部抽取其电力，将会使其产生强烈反抗。
在黄色核心电池被破坏后，长明灯将会倒地。假如此时周围有其他尚能活动的长明灯，则它会移动到倒地的同伴身边对其充电复活，因此，需要同时击败周围所有个体才能将其泯除。
在该异象泯除后，由其行为导致的供电设施损坏会自行复原，周围的雾气也会消失。

【异象奇点】
单个个体在黄色核心电池被击破后即陷入瘫痪。若要完全泯除，需要同时击倒区域内所有个体。

【风险评估】
其行为影响居民正常生活，且存在爆炸风险，建议发现后及时泯除。

【收容/担保情况】
收容成本过高，研究价值过低，不建议收容，一般以泯除处理。

【收容措施】
需要持续为收容单元供给电量。

【实验记录】
实验①
抽取「长明灯」个体内部电力，个体表现出强烈攻击行为；电力被全部抽取后，个体发生自爆。
实验②
尝试持续为「长明灯」供给充足电量，电量被持续吸收，直至实验因实验室小规模停电结束。
判断该异象收容成本过高，研究价值过低，不建议收容。

【衍生异象】
无

【延展信息】
无
Desc.LocalizedString:
Anomaly Story
The Eternal Lamp is an Anomaly that emerged with the invention of electric lighting, having transformed from discarded light bulbs.
In the earliest records, the Eternal Lamp looked very different from its current form, appearing as an ordinary small light bulb. Its unique ability was being able to glow continuously without any attached power supply. Research revealed that the Eternal Lamp was actually siphoning electricity from other light bulbs to do so. Within a one-kilometer radius, all other bulbs would dim noticeably.
As technology advanced and new types of electric lights replaced old bulbs, the Eternal Lamp gradually completed its evolution: no longer limited to stealing power from lights alone, it began stealing all forms of electricity. Its appearance also became larger and more aggressive.
The survival pressure on the Eternal Lamp drove its evolution, and the abundance of electricity of the new era provided the perfect source of energy for this transformation. Under these favorable conditions, the Eternal Lamp completed its metamorphosis from a mere light bulb to its current form. It seems anomalies are not static after their creation, but can adapt and change over time.

Anomaly Characteristics
This Anomaly commonly appears in groups in alleyways at night, plunging the surrounding area into power outages accompanied by spreading black fog. Entire blocks succumb into darkness, severely disrupting residents' daily lives.
Additionally, its stealing behavior damages the circuit boards of power facilities. After charging itself to full capacity, the anomaly enters a satiated state and gradually grows stronger, requiring ever more electricity.
This Anomaly appears extremely stingy with its stored power, strictly controlling electricity usage with each attack. Attempting to drain its power externally will provoke intense resistance.
After the yellow core battery is destroyed, the Eternal Lamp will collapse. If other active Eternal Lamps are nearby, they will move to recharge their fallen companion, bringing it back into the battle. Therefore, all Eternal Lamps in the area must be defeated simultaneously to achieve nullification.
After this Anomaly undergoes nullification, the power it siphoned will return, any damage caused will restore itself, and the surrounding fog will dissipate.

Anomaly Nexus
A single Eternal Lamp becomes paralyzed once its yellow core battery is destroyed. Complete nullification requires defeating all Eternal Lamps in the area simultaneously.

Risk Assessment
Its behavior disrupts residents' normal lives and poses an explosion risk. Prompt nullification upon discovery is recommended.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Containment costs are too high and research value too low. Containment is not recommended. Standard protocol is nullification.

Containment Measures
Requires continuous power supply to the containment unit.

Experiment Records
Experiment 1
Drained electricity from an Eternal Lamp individual. The subject exhibited intense aggressive behavior. After complete power extraction, the subject self-destructed.
Experiment 2
Attempted to continuously supply sufficient electricity to an Eternal Lamp. Power was continuously absorbed until the experiment was terminated due to a small-scale laboratory blackout.
Conclusion: Containment costs for this Anomaly are too high and research value too low. Containment is not recommended.

Derivative Anomaly
None

Extended Info
None

Desc.SourceString:
「我们在虚实之间戳了一个小洞，而后狂想的洪流倾泻而下。」

【异象故事】
有这样一个先锋艺术团体，其中的每一名成员都是才华横溢的作家，他们举办了一场以交流创作技巧为目的的「创作接力」活动。思想的交流与碰撞，经由笔尖流淌成墨迹，汇聚成了一股看不见的思潮，诞生了无数瑰丽的想象世界，演绎了一段段令人难忘的精彩故事。随着时间推移，这场创作活动的参与者渐渐如着魔般，痴迷于他们笔下的文字，被这股思想的洪流裹挟着继续创作。最终在某一天，他们全都聚集在一起，声称要探究「意识的终极」，然后共同进入了一间宅邸，自此闭门谢客。
最开始，人们认为这只是一次普通的闭关创作，对于作家——特别是那些优秀的作家而言，这并不是什么稀奇的事情。但是自他们进入宅邸的那天起，宅邸的大门就再未打开。他们的仆人、朋友、家人出于担心前往探访，却没有一人成功打开宅邸的门。直到几周之后，宅邸的大门自行开启，然而其中出现的并非作家们，而是一股真正的「意识洪流」，所到之处的空间尽皆变成一副光怪陆离的场景。此时的那扇「门」已经成为了连接现实与「门后世界」的通道，成为了一个异象。好在其危害扩大之前就被某民间异象猎人团体收容，后来几经辗转，目前由惠比寿拍卖行保存。

「回转门外」，编号R-3407[Ob]，外观为一扇由彩绘玻璃拼接而成的「门」。「门」后面的另一个世界，我们称其为「门后世界」，是一个由创作者的狂想构成的混乱的空间。当该异象被打开后，会有汹涌的「意识洪流」从中流出，其所席卷之处都会逐渐变成「门后世界」的一部分，被癫狂的意识侵蚀：重力变得异常、空间变得破碎而扭曲、出现不应存在于现实中的生物。该异象的侵蚀范围会随时间推移而逐渐扩大，且在历史观察记录中没有发现其范围扩大的上限。如果放任不管，大约八、九个月之后，「门后世界」就会扩张到足以吞噬一整座城市。
打开后，由于空间的错位，「回转门外」会随影响范围的扩大呈现出复数个「门」，但只有一扇「门」——最后一扇，是该异象的本体。「门」之间以「意识洪流」作为纽带连接，而「意识洪流」又是在「门后世界」破碎的空间之间移动的主要纽带。只要关闭所有的「门」，「回转门外」就会重新变回普通大门的样子，因此理论上只要循着「意识洪流」移动，一扇扇关闭所有的「门」就能够收容该异象。然而需要注意的是，「意识洪流」的本质是癫狂的意识，浸没其中的人将不可避免地收到其影响，逐渐产生环视、幻听，甚至更严重的精神问题。在收容过程中，需要留心「门后世界」里另一种相对不起眼的物质——「理智水滴」。其与「意识洪流」一样看上去是液体，但和奔涌不息的「意识洪流」不同的是，它往往是静止不动的水球。通过接触「理智水滴」，不仅可以减轻收容异象过程中受到的精神污染，还能够一定程度上稳定周围的「意识洪流」，使浸入其中移动对意识的影响大大减轻。
触碰「理智水滴」并不是毫无代价的。「回转门外」诞生自作家的狂想之中——而理智对它而言如同毒药。触碰「理智水滴」会招致该异象的反击，有时是伴生异象的攻击，也有时是突然的幻觉，又或者是不稳定的「意识洪流」中的意识捏造出的什么攻击手段……越是安抚它，它的抵抗就会越激烈，所以拖得时间越长，要解决这个异象就会越棘手。

每个时代都有些超越时代的头脑，有些被称为天才，有些则被斥为疯子。他们的思想在常人看来可能过于怪诞，甚至触及了疯狂的边缘，但也同样充满魅力。他们的狂想可能无法成为现实，但异象却有着化不可能为可能的能力。「回转门后」给了我们一个机会，可以一窥他们思想的一隅。

【异象特性】
·该异象外观是一扇彩绘玻璃拼接成的大门，门后联通着一个不遵循现实规则的「门后世界」。
·该异象开启后，会涌出水流状的「意识洪流」，其所过之处会被「门后世界」侵蚀而变得失序，侵蚀范围随时间扩大。
·「门后世界」的影响范围内会出现复数个「门」，互相以「意识洪流」连接，可以借助「意识洪流」进行移动。
·浸入「意识洪流」会导致幻觉和精神问题，触碰水球状的「理智水滴」可以缓解症状，但也会招致该异象的敌意。

【异象奇点】
关闭所有连接现实与「门后世界」的「门」。

【风险评估】
中等风险。

【收容/担保情况】
由惠比寿拍卖行担保。

【收容措施】
关闭的「回转门外」可以存放在任何足以容纳它的空间里。考虑到「开门」是导致该异象解离的诱因，建议将其平放在坚实的平面上。

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"We poked a small hole between reality and illusion, and a torrent of wild imagination came flooding through."

Anomaly Story
There once existed an avant-garde art collective composed of extraordinarily talented writers. They organized a creative technique exchange, with this collision of ideas flowing from their pens as ink. Ideas converged into the invisible current of thought that gave birth to countless magnificent imaginary worlds and unforgettable stories. As time passed, the participants in this creative endeavor felt their obsession grow, as if enchanted by the words they wrote, rushed forwards by this torrent of thought to ink the next stroke to paper. One day, they all gathered together, claiming they would explore "the ultimate nature of consciousness," then entered a mansion together and shut themselves away from the world.
At first, people assumed this was merely an ordinary creative retreat. For eccentric and talented writers, this was nothing unusual. But from the day they entered the mansion, its doors never opened again… Their servants, friends, and family members visited out of concern, yet not one of them could pry open the mansion's doors. Several weeks later, the mansion doors suddenly creaked opened on their own. However, what emerged was not the writers, but a true torrent of consciousness. Every area it touched was transformed into a bizarre and surreal scene! By then, that door had become an Anomaly passage connecting reality to the "World Beyond the Door," spreading out of control. Fortunately, it was contained by an independent Anomaly Hunter group before its influence could spread further. After changing hands several times, it is currently held by the Ebisu Auction House.

Outside the Inner Door, designated R-3407(Ob), appears as a door composed of stained glass panels. The other world it opens to, which we call the World Beyond the Door, is a chaotic space formed from its creators' wild imaginings. When this Anomaly is opened, a surging "torrent of consciousness" flows out in an instant, sweeping through the area. Everywhere it extends through gradually becomes part of the World Beyond the Door, eroded by maddened consciousness. It becomes a zone where gravity acts abnormal, space becomes fragmented and twisted, and creatures that should not exist in reality manifest freely. The range of this Anomaly expands rapidly, and historical observation records show no limit to its expansion. If left unchecked, the World Beyond the Door will become large enough to devour an entire city in approximately eight to nine months.
Once opened, due to spatial displacement, Outside the Inner Door manifests as multiple doors as its area of influence expands. Only one of these doors, the final one, is the true form of this Anomaly. The doors are connected by the "torrent of consciousness," which also serves as the primary means of movement between the fragmented spaces of the World Beyond the Door. As long as all the doors are closed, Outside the Inner Door will maintain the appearance of an ordinary door. Therefore, in theory, following the "torrent of consciousness" and closing each door one by one should allow for the containment of this Anomaly. However, it should be noted that the essence of the "torrent of consciousness" is a maddened consciousness. Anyone submerged in it will inevitably be affected, experiencing visual and auditory hallucinations, or developing more severe mental issues. During the containment process, one must watch for another relatively inconspicuous substance in the World Beyond the Door: the "droplets of reason." Like the "torrent of consciousness," these appear to be liquid in form, but unlike the ceaselessly surging torrent, they are often stationary spheres of water. Touching the "droplets of reason" will reduce the mental contamination suffered during the containment process, and also stabilize the surrounding "torrent of consciousness" to some degree, allowing passage with less risk to one's sanity.
Touching the "droplets of reason" is not without a price, however. Outside the Inner Door was born from the wild imaginings of writers, and reason is like poison to them. Touching the "droplets of reason" will provoke retaliation from the Anomaly. This retaliation is sometimes in the form of Surge Anomaly attacks, sometimes sudden hallucinations, or attacks fabricated by the consciousness within the unstable "torrent of consciousness"… The longer you take, the more difficult this Anomaly becomes to resolve.

Every era has great minds that attempt to transcend their limits. Some are called geniuses; others are dismissed as madmen. Their ideas may seem too bizarre to ordinary people, even touching the edge of madness, but they are equally captivating. Their wildest ideas may never normally become reality, but Anomalies have the power to make the impossible possible. Outside the Inner Door gives us an opportunity to glimpse a corner of their unknowable minds.

Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly appears as a large door made of stained glass panels. Behind the door is a World Beyond the Door that does not follow the rules of reality.
· When this Anomaly is opened, a water-like "torrent of consciousness" surges forth. Everywhere it passes is eroded by the World Beyond the Door and becomes disordered. The erosion range expands over time.
· Multiple doors appear within the affected area of the World Beyond the Door, interconnected by the "torrent of consciousness." One can move through the "torrent of consciousness."
· Immersion in the "torrent of consciousness" causes hallucinations and mental issues. Touching the spherical "droplets of reason" can alleviate symptoms but will also provoke hostility from the Anomaly.

Anomaly Nexus
Close all doors connecting reality to the World Beyond the Door.

Risk Assessment
Medium.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Guaranteed by the Ebisu Auction House.

Containment Measures
The closed Outside the Inner Door can be stored in any space large enough to accommodate it. Considering that opening the door is the trigger for an breach, it is recommended to lay it flat on a solid surface.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
「然而却无一道目光为其停留。」

【异象故事】
杰出的画作由于艺术家的知名度和作品的稀缺性，在人类历史长河中，辗转数名收藏家之手 ，即使因为个人品味和时代特征而短暂蒙尘，也会因为其蕴含的「艺术价值」于世间重放光彩。而一直陪伴「名画」，经历历史磨练的「画框」，却时常随着持有者的品味不断被更换。
每一位观赏「名画」的观众，都一定会看见「画框」，但人们热切地探讨着画面的色彩、构图和寓意时，却对画框不置一词。人们越是狂热地追捧「名画」，就越是认为起到保护和展示作用的「画框」只是可有可无的陪衬，甚至认为它拉低了画作本身的品味。
如果摆脱了画作的束缚，「画框」能否得到一句赞美呢？也许是这样的执念，让被认为是「名画」陪衬品的画框，滋长出了控诉自身不公遭遇的力量，在人们又一次聚精会神地欣赏画作时成为了异象「无画框」。

制造光怪陆离的空间，泼洒颜料的攻击方式，「无画框」的能力似乎仍然与其曾经框裱的画作高度相关。如果「无画框」有思想，这样的现实应该是相当令它沮丧的吧？
或许正是这种沮丧导致了「无画框」的攻击性。换一个角度来看，它制造空间异常的动机或许是博取关注，而对卷入空间异常之中的人的攻击行为更像是……生闷气？毕竟对于被卷入空间异常的人而言，对多变又美丽的「画中世界」的惊叹越多，又或是恐惧越深，就越像是在讽刺「无画框」自身的平庸……也会因此引来它的报复。
这样的举动听起来有点孩子气，但对于拥有强大力量的异象而言，即使是耍脾气，也会对周围造成损害。

不过，离开了「画作」的「画框」，还能被称作是「画框」吗？或者说，世界上总有些为了「陪衬」而被制造出来，依附于「主要个体」存在的东西对吧？框裱画作用的画框，甚至被用作房屋装饰的画作，这些东西都有成为异象的「潜质」吗？还是说「无画框」恰巧具备了某种特质吗？
……这种问题还是留给学者们去头疼吧。或许下次去「金苹果」藏馆的时候我应该向陈列柜致意？这算是防止异象产生的有效措施吗？

【异象特性】
·该异象在一次公开画展中突然形成，具体形成原因未知，在异象管理局抵达前已经造成现场多名观众受伤。
·通常状态下为普通画框，形态变换后主体为六芒星形物体，整个六芒星外表面被油画颜料覆盖，表面有层叠的纹理层次，且持续循环波动。
·负责收容该异象的异象管理局成员在报告中描述，该异象可以在低空飞行、旋转，具有攻击性，可以喷射颜料攻击周围的物体和人，外形会根据战斗的形态变化。
·该异象似乎具有突破「空间」限制的能力，在异象能力发动时，可以自行制造一个小型的「异象空间」，并在空间中呈现「现实」的元素场景。根据推测，异象的能力可能与它曾经「框裱」过的画作有关，由于观众对于画作的想象力（也许还有过度解读），在该异象制造的空间中，会出现一些叠加、拼凑、不合常规的景象。
·对「画框」的赞美之词，即使并非发自真心，似乎也能安抚该异象，使其破坏性显著降低。

【异象奇点】
得到发自真心的赞美和认可。

【风险评估】
由于兼具引发空间异常现象的能力和主动攻击性，「无画框」对意外卷入其中的一般民众具有较大的威胁，但对于异象管理局的专业人士和有一定经验的异象猎人，保全自身的难度并不算高。鉴于其突破了异象管理局的临时收容措施，其潜在风险可能更高，但考虑到该异象已经泯除，暂不作进一步推测。

【收容/担保情况】
异象管理局对其进行临时收容后发生解离，由异象管理局收容二组成员薄荷与一名异象猎人共同泯除。

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Yet not a single gaze lingers upon it."

Anomaly Story
Outstanding paintings, due to the artist's fame and the work's rarity, may pass through the hands of untold numbers of collectors throughout history. Even when temporarily obscured by personal taste and era-specific preferences, they are bound to reappear thanks to their inherent artistic value. However, the frames that have accompanied these masterpieces and endured the trials of history are often replaced according to their new owners' tastes.
Every viewer who admires a masterpiece will certainly see the frame, but when people eagerly discuss the painting's colors, composition, and meaning, not one word is spared for it. The more fervently people pursue masterpieces, the more they consider the frame, which serves to protect and display, as merely a dispensable decoration, some even believing it diminishes the painting's refined taste.
If freed from the constraints of paintings, could a frame earn even a single word of praise? Perhaps it was this obsession that allowed the frame, considered a mere accessory to masterpieces, to develop the power to protest its unjust treatment, becoming the Anomaly Picture Frame.

Creating bizarre spaces and attacking by splashing paint, Picture Frame's abilities still seem closely related to the paintings it once framed… If Picture Frame has consciousness, such a reality must be quite disheartening for it, right?
Perhaps this very frustration led to Picture Frame's aggressive nature. From another perspective, its motivation for creating Anomalous Realms might be to seek attention, whereas its attacks on those caught in Anomalous Realm might seem more tantrum-like…? For those swept into the Anomalous Realm, marveling at the ever-changing, beautiful "world within paintings," might be percieved as mocking Picture Frame's own mediocrity… provoking its retaliation.
Such behavior sounds somewhat childish, but for an Anomaly with such powerful abilities, even throwing a tantrum can cause immense damage to its surroundings.

Can a frame separated from its painting still be called a "frame"? Or rather, there are things in this world which always serve as accessories, dependent on primary entities, right? Frames used to frame paintings, or even paintings used as house decorations… Do all these things have the potential to become anomalies? Or did Picture Frame happen to possess some special quality?
…Such questions are better left for scholars. Perhaps next time I visit the Gold Apple Collection Hall, I should pay my respects to the display cases…? Would that count as an effective measure to prevent Anomaly formation?

Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly suddenly manifested during a public art exhibition. The specific cause of formation is unknown. Multiple audience members were injured before the Bureau of Anomaly Control arrived.
· In its normal state, it appears as a common picture frame. After transformation, its main body becomes a hexagram-shaped object. The entire hexagram's outer surface is covered with oil paint, with layered textural depths that continuously undulate.
· Bureau of Anomaly Control members responsible for containing this Anomaly described in their reports that it can fly and rotate at low altitudes, possesses aggressive tendencies, sprays paint to attack its surroundings, and changes appearance according to battle conditions.
· This Anomaly appears to have the ability to transcend spatial limitations. When its powers activate, it can independently create a small Anomalous Realm and manifest real elemental scenes within the space. Based on speculation, the Anomaly's abilities may be related to paintings it once framed. Due to audience imagination (and perhaps over-interpretation) of paintings, layered, patchwork, and otherwise unconventional scenes appear in the spaces this Anomaly creates.
· Words of praise for Picture Frame, even if not heartfelt, seem able to pacify the Anomaly and significantly reduce its destructiveness.

Anomaly Nexus
Receiving genuine praise and recognition.

Risk Assessment
Due to its ability to trigger Anomalous Realm phenomena and active aggressiveness, Picture Frame poses a considerable threat to civilians accidentally caught in its effects. For Bureau of Anomaly Control professionals and experienced Anomaly Hunters, however, danger is not particularly great. Given that it breached the Bureau of Anomaly Control's Temporary containment measures, its potential risk may be higher, but considering this Anomaly has undergone nullification, no further speculation will be made.

Containment/Guarantee Status
After temporary containment by the Bureau of Anomaly Control resulted in breach, it was jointly nullified by Bureau of Anomaly Control, CSU-2 member Mint, and an Anomaly Hunter.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
「主演谢幕之前，谁都不许停下舞步！」

【异象故事】
在贵族们的时代远没有我们今天多样且便利的娱乐消遣。举办晚宴，在推杯换盏间，通过物质的攀比炫耀财富和地位，就成了上流社会最常见的取乐方式之一。当时有一块材质独特的珍惜布料问世，不出预料地成为了众人瞩目的焦点。谁能用这块稀有的材料，织出独一无二的华服？两位有名的裁缝名家共享了这份殊荣，为一位名媛缝制一件晚礼服。其中一位名为克劳奇，而另一位的名字则消失在历史中。二人既是合作者，又是竞争者，都想在晚礼服上做出最夺目的设计。如此诞生的作品没有辜负创作者的心意，让穿上它的名媛成为了名副其实的「舞会皇后」，随着她的舞步，越来越多的人在由衷赞叹的同时加入了这场狂欢。
然而这样的欢愉并未持续太久。随着舞会进行，身穿华丽晚礼服的「舞会皇后」表情变得扭曲，而周围的宾客也意识到自己的舞步变得无法停止，一种无形的力量像是摆弄提线木偶一样，控制着他们的身体。一些贵族试图帮助他们停下，但靠近后，他们身上的礼服也仿佛受到牵引，拉拽着他们加入了这场疯狂的舞会。恐惧蔓延，还未受到影响的贵族纷纷逃离，而受到影响的贵族们则只能不停地舞蹈，直到力竭倒地。
当人们再次回到一片狼藉的舞会现场时，「舞会皇后」仍在独舞，周围遍是倒地的贵族。「舞会皇后」向众人鞠躬——虽然此时她早已气绝，仍在晚礼服的影响下完成谢幕，才倒地不起。众人回收了礼服，逮捕了两位制作者。最终，克劳奇在狱中畏罪自杀，而没有留下名字的那位裁缝，则带着这套晚礼服神秘失踪。

R-4317[Ob]，「永不谢幕的阿拉克涅」，外观是一套深红色女款晚礼服。其面料是独特的丝绸质地，摸上去手感非常光滑，但是与皮肤接触时，布料会贴合、黏附在皮肤上，很难再次剥离。我当然没穿过，我也并不好奇他们是怎么总结出这段描述的……但是这种特性，很容易让人联想起蛛丝，好奇这材料的出处。
作为一个Ⅴ级异象，永不谢幕的阿拉克涅的收容措施简单得出乎意料，只要像普通的衣服一样整理好再装进封闭容器里就可以了。然而，任何目睹永不谢幕的阿拉克涅的人，都会惊异于它的美，并产生穿上它试试的冲动。这种冲动会随着目视时间而逐渐增强，疑似具有干扰心智的能力，但并不是永久性的，阻断视线后，穿上它的冲动会很快消失。
在永不谢幕的阿拉克涅具有足够的活动空间（足够容纳一个成年人张开双臂站立的空间）时，如果有人怀着好奇靠近该异象，就会导致该异象开始活动。该异象会生成若干衍生异象，随后，处于其影响范围内的人，会感受到躯体仿佛受到蛛丝牵引般，想要加入这场「共舞」。一旦加入其中，就只能在无尽舞蹈中力竭。如果拒绝与它共舞，又或是奉上的「演出」不足以取悦它，那么就会受到永不谢幕的阿拉克涅的无情攻击。
想要泯除或收容阿拉克涅，必须先消灭其伴生异象。随后，永不谢幕的阿拉克涅会亲自以灵敏且精巧的舞步发起攻击，就连舞曲和灯光都会成为它的武器。被攻击者必须同样以精妙的步伐作出回应，躲开那些致命的攻击，并抓住机会进行反击。在战斗最激烈时，战斗场地会陷入黑暗，只有被「聚光灯」照亮的区域清晰可见，离开明亮的区域会导致行动逐渐迟缓。该异象的攻击对象必须在聚光灯下与其完成最后的共演，而如果在此过程中战胜了永不谢幕的阿拉克涅，完成了一场精彩的演出，那么永不谢幕的阿拉克涅就会「谢幕」，变成一件普通的晚礼服。

永不谢幕的阿拉克涅自人的物欲诞生，目的是满足人的嫉妒攀比之心。哪怕成为了异象，它依然是舞会永远的焦点，哪怕「舞会」和「永远」以一种出人意料的形式实现。不论当时的贵族身份如何显赫，时代已经变了，就连「贵族」都成为了历史书上的符号。对永不谢幕的阿拉克涅来说，不再有无休无止的舞会供它征服了，它最好的归宿，或许就是在收容单元里作为那个时代的缩影而存续。

【异象特性】
·该异象会诱惑目击者穿上它，在有人怀着好奇靠近时开始活动。
·该异象会强制要求靠近者与其「共舞」，顺从者会不断舞蹈，直到力竭。
·拒绝与该异象共舞，会受到该异象的攻击。想要泯除它，最终还是要进行一次盛大的「谢幕演出」。

【异象奇点】
共同上演一场盛大的谢幕演出。

【风险评估】
中等危害。

【收容/担保情况】
未收容。

【收容措施】
妥善封存在狭小的封闭容器内。

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"No one may stop dancing until the star takes her final bow!"

Anomaly Story
In the era of the aristocracy, there were far fewer forms of entertainment than we have the luxury to enjoy today. Banquets, where hosts would flaunt wealth and status through material extravagance over glasses of wine, became one of the most common pastimes of high society. In that era, a rare and unique fabric material came into existence and, unsurprisingly, drew the eye of many looking to show off. Who would be the first to weave an unparalleled gown from this rare material? Two famous master tailors shared this honor, commissioned jointly to create an evening dress for a socialite. One was named Crouch, while the other's name has been lost to history. They were both collaborators and competitors, each striving to create the most dazzling design for the gown. As a result, the dress lived up to its makers' intentions, transforming the lady who wore it into a true "Prom Queen." As she danced, more and more guests joined the revelry, genuinely captivated.
However, such joy did not last long. As the ball continued, the expression of the "Prom Queen" in her magnificent evening gown became twisted, and the surrounding guests realized they could no longer stop dancing. An invisible force, like strings manipulating marionettes, binded their limbs, controlling their movements. Some nobles tried to intervene, but upon approaching, their own formal attire seemed to be afflicted, dragging them too into this mad dance. Fear spread, and those not yet controlled fled, while the affected nobles could only keep dancing until they collapsed from exhaustion.
When people returned to the devastated ballroom, the "Prom Queen" was still dancing alone, surrounded by fallen nobles. The "Prom Queen" bowed to the audience. Though she had long since perished, she still completed her curtain call under the dress's influence before finally collapsing. The dress was recovered, and both tailors were arrested. In the end, Crouch took his own life in prison out of guilt, but the nameless tailor mysteriously disappeared along with the evening gown.

R-4317(Ob), "The Never-ending Arachne," appears as a deep crimson women's evening gown. The fabric has a unique silky texture, extremely smooth to the touch. When in contact with skin, the fabric adheres and clings tightly, making it very difficult to remove. I certainly have never worn it, and I am not curious about how they came up with this description… But this description easily brings spider silk to mind, making one wonder about the material's origins.
As a Class V Anomaly, The Never-ending Arachne has surprisingly simple containment measures. It only needs to be folded like clothing and placed in a sealed container. However, anyone who witnesses The Never-ending Arachne will be amazed by its beauty and feel a strong urge to try it on. This urge gradually intensifies with viewing, suggesting a possible mind-affecting ability, but it is not permanent. Once the line of sight is broken, the urge to wear it quickly fades.
When The Never-ending Arachne has sufficient space to move (enough to accommodate an adult standing with arms outstretched), if a poor curious soul approaches the Anomaly, it will activate. The Anomaly will generate several Derivative Anomalies. Subsequently, anyone within its area of influence will feel their body being pulled as if by spider threads, wanting to join in this "dance." Once they join, they can only dance endlessly until exhaustion. If one refuses to dance with it, or if the "performance" offered is not enough to please it, The Never-ending Arachne will attack without mercy.
To nullify or contain The Never-ending Arachne, one must first eliminate its Surge Anomalies. Then, The Never-ending Arachne will personally attack with nimble and elaborate dance steps. Even the music and lighting become its weapons. Those attacked must respond with equally exquisite footwork, dodging those deadly attacks and seizing any opportunities to counterattack. At the height of the battle, the arena will plunge into darkness, with only areas illuminated by "spotlights" clearly visible. Leaving the lit areas will cause one's movements to gradually slow. The target must complete a final duet with it under the spotlight. If they defeat The Never-ending Arachne during this process and deliver a spectacular performance, The Never-ending Arachne will "take its bow" and become an ordinary evening gown.

The Never-ending Arachne was born from human material desire, meant to satisfy envy and the urge to compete. Even as an Anomaly, it remains the eternal center of the ball, even if the "ball" and "eternity" were realized in unexpected ways. No matter how distinguished those aristocrats were, things have changed, and even "aristocracy" has become nothing more than a symbol in history books. For The Never-ending Arachne, there are no more endless balls left for it to conquer. Perhaps its best fate is to remain in a containment unit as a relic of that era.

Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly tempts witnesses to wear it and begins to activate when someone approaches with curiosity.
· This Anomaly forces those who approach to "dance" with it. Those who comply will dance continuously until they collapse from exhaustion.
· Refusing to dance with this Anomaly will result in it attacking. To nullify it, one must ultimately perform a grand "curtain call."

Anomaly Nexus
Perform a grand curtain call together.

Risk Assessment
Moderate hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not in containment.

Containment Measures
Properly seal in a small, enclosed container.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
光线进入你的双眼，经过神经的传递和大脑的修正成为你所见的像。你看见的并非你真正看见的。你看到幻觉。

画家作画，通常是在描摹真实。画中出现的事物，我们理所当然地信以为真，鲜少意识到「那不过是一张纸上的一些颜料」。某位天才的画家意识到画作的欺骗性，以及我们双眼的欺骗性，开始绘制充满错视幻觉的奇妙图像。
于是，异象在画家的画布上诞生了。画布联通了纸上世界和现实世界，在观察者的视觉中构建出一个新的「画布」。当观察者意识到画作和现实的联系性后，会被带入一个奇诡的异象空间，唯有理解幻象的本质解开谜题，才能离开。
该异象并不具备危险性，被带入异象空间的观察者仅仅是在其中进行类似梦境的体验，不会影响其身体和精神。离开异象空间后，观察者会发现自己仅仅是「走神片刻」而已。
最初创作这些异象画作的画家已经辞世，他生前的画作流传在世界各地，这些画作均带有异象性质，常有人因此被带入异象空间。
由于该异象并不会对人造成实质性伤害，并且画作大多为私人收藏，故暂不对其进行大规模收容。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Light enters your eyes, travels through your nerves, and processed by your brain, becoming the images you perceive. What you see is not what you truly see. What you see is an illusion.

When painters create their works, they are usually depicting reality. Some take the things that appear in paintings as truth, without realizing that they are merely pigment on a canvas. A certain genius painter grew aware of the deceptive nature of painting, as well as the gullibility of our vision, and began to create wondrous images filled with optical illusions.
An anomaly was thus born on the painter's canvas, which connects the world of art to the real world, constructing a new "canvas" with the spectator's vision. When spectators realize the connection between the painting and reality, they will be drawn into a strange Anomalous Realm, from which they can leave only when they grasp the true nature of the illusion and solve the puzzles within.
This anomaly poses no danger. Spectators brought into the Anomalous Realm merely undergo a dream-like experience, with no effect on their bodies or minds. After leaving the Anomalous Realm, spectators merely feel they "spaced out for a moment."
The painter who created these anomalous works of this kind has passed away. His paintings are scattered around the world. All of them possess anomalous properties and draw people into Anomalous Realms from time to time.
Since these anomalies does not cause any substantial harm, not to mention most of the paintings are in private collections, large-scale containment efforts are not needed at this time.

Desc.SourceString:
「动次打次！奇可塔可！随着节奏一起摇摆，引爆全场！」

【异象故事】
克莱门音乐角曾是个热闹的地方。每到放课后，在那个设施简陋的公共演出广场，总会有一群吵闹的学生在此集会，用音符和跃动引爆整个夜晚。舞台中央，DJ的指尖划过碟机，掀起一阵又一阵的音浪。激烈的「动次打次」撞击心跳，轻快的「奇可塔可」伴随舞步。欢快的节奏如潮水般在舞台中央漫开，吸引着越来越多的人加入到这片跃动的音符海洋之中。
但随着时间流逝，最初的那群人逐渐长大，毕业，离开，克莱门音乐角也渐渐冷清下来……
……直到「它」的出现。
「大半夜的，怎么这么大声……」克莱门学园东门的保安揉了揉疲乏的睡眼，望着音乐角的方向皱起了眉头。
「……难道是演出？电音社的那群臭小子不是好几年前就都毕业了么……」
当他拿着手电筒，来到音乐角的公共演出广场时，却没有见到记忆中的那番热闹场景——没有打碟的DJ，没有舞动的人群，只有一组泛着荧光的、悬浮于广场中央的演出设备。那些印着电音社Logo的涂鸦的音箱、键盘和屏幕似乎组成了某种活物，自动播放着低沉却紧凑的鼓点。几个好奇胆大的学生正在围观它，荧光投影在广场周围升起，围成一块舞池，屏幕上的音量光柱随着低频的鼓点不安分地跳动着，仿佛在密谋一场狂欢。
突然，它的显示屏猛然亮起，极其热烈的音乐响起，一道道将节奏具象化的「音浪」震荡而来。学生们只能尽力躲避，在舞池中笨拙地扭动身体。但它的节奏越来越快，一层层音浪扑面而来，开始有人踩错节奏，被那音浪直接击中、推飞到场地边缘，眼冒金星地昏倒在地。而剩下的年轻挑战者们却越来越兴奋，完成这场律动挑战……
「这是……异象吗？得赶快联系异象管理局！」见到这一幕的保安慌忙拿起手机，只见一道绿色的身影如疾风般闯入广场，纵身跃入舞台中央。
「收容二组薄荷，前来支援——呜啊啊啊这是什么东西！」
虽然有些生硬，薄荷凭借敏捷的动作躲避那组设备释放出的、愈发密集的音浪，渐渐地，她找到了一些节奏上的规律，开始一边游刃有余地应对，一边试图救助那些在地面上眼冒金星、时不时被音浪抛到空中又落下的倒霉蛋们。
PERFECT!PERFECT!PERFECT——广场的荧光大屏上一次次跳出完美的打击判定，围观的人群越来越多，绿色的身影在密集的音波攻击中迅捷地穿梭，把昏迷的学生一个个扛出了舞池范围……在所有学生都得救的时刻，那组设备在键盘上有力地敲下最后一个音符，发出一阵的电流嘶响，散落一地。克莱门音乐角又重新恢复了宁静。
「呼……真是个难缠的异象，得赶紧把学生们送医——哎？！」
人群爆发出掌声和欢呼，薄荷一抬眼，才发现演出广场早已围满了观众。
「居然一次失误都没有！太厉害了……」
「能再来一次吗！我刚刚没录全！」
「这曲子好耳熟……难道是那个天才DJ回来了？！」
……
保安在欢闹的人群中不自觉地笑着，也跟着鼓起掌来。
真是久违的热闹啊。

【异象特性】
·该异象由一组电子音乐制作及演出设备构成。这些设备可在未通电情况下自行运转，并组合成特定形态、自主行动。
·该异象具有类似关闭与激活的状态切换。关闭状态下，其表现为倒放在广场中的设备；激活后，该异象将悬浮并自主行动，对广场内人员发起挑战。
·挑战启动时，该异象将播放电子音乐，并在广场内形成示意音量的荧光投影。其发起挑战行为的原因尚未探明，但可确认的是，该异象会依照音乐节奏发起攻击，迫使被挑战者做出契合律动的动作。如果被挑战者动作失误，会受到强烈的声浪攻击，严重可致昏迷。
·该异象疑似具备自主创作音乐的能力，其创作的音乐作品已引起许多市民的关注和喜爱。

【异象奇点】
在其演出区域内，根据音乐节奏做出与之契合的动作，并穿插攻击，将其战胜。

【风险评估】
中等危害。

【收容/担保情况】
未收容。

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Boots and cats! Chika-taka! Sway to the rhythm and blow up the crowd!"

Anomaly Story
Clement Music Corner was once a lively place. Every day after school, a rowdy group of students would gather at that modest public performance plaza to set the night ablaze with beats and movement. On center stage, the DJ's fingertips would glide across the turntables, sending wave after wave of sound crashing over the crowd. Music shakes hearts, and dance moves eyes. The upbeat rhythm spread like a tide through the students, drawing more and more people into this ocean of pulsing notes.
But as time passed, as those original students gradually grew up, graduated, and left, Clement Music Corner slowly grew quiet…
…Until "it" appeared.
"Why is it so loud in the middle of the night…" The security guard at Clement Academy's east gate rubbed his tired eyes and frowned in the direction of the Music Corner.
"…Is there a performance? Didn't those kids from the electronic music club all graduate years ago…?"
Upon arrival at the performance plaza, his flashlight didn't illuminate the lively scene from his memories. There was no DJ spinning tracks, no dancing crowd. Only a set of performance equipment floating in the center of the plaza, glowing with fluorescent light. The speakers, keyboards, and screens, all covered in graffiti bearing the electronic music club's logo, seemed to have formed some kind of living creature, automatically playing a deep yet tight drumbeat. A few curious and bold students were gathered around it. Fluorescent projections filled the plaza, forming a dance floor, and the volume bars on the screen jumped restlessly to the low-frequency beat, as if plotting a wild party.
Suddenly, the display lit up brilliantly, and incredibly intense music began to blare out! Wave after wave of "sound blasts" that materialized from the rhythm came crashing toward them, and the students could only try their best to dodge, awkwardly twisting their bodies on the dance floor. The tempo kept increasing, layer upon layer of sound waves rushing at them. Some started missing the beat and were hit directly by the sound waves, sent flying to the edge of the venue, collapsing with stars in their eyes. Yet the remaining young challengers grew more and more excited as they completed the Rhythm Challenge…
"Is this… an Anomaly? I need to contact the Bureau right away!" The security guard who witnessed this hurriedly pulled out his phone, only to see a green figure dash into the plaza like a gust of wind, leaping into the center of the stage.
"CSU-2, Mint, here to assist… Whoa, what is this thing?!"
Though a bit stiff at first, Mint dodged the increasingly dense sound waves released by the equipment. Gradually, she found some patterns in the rhythm and began handling things with ease while trying to rescue those poor souls on the ground, seeing stars and occasionally getting tossed into the air by sound waves before falling back down.
PERFECT! PERFECT! PERFECT! The fluorescent big screen in the plaza displayed perfect hit judgments one after another, as the crowd of onlookers only grew larger. The green figure swiftly weaved through the dense barrage of sonic attacks, carrying the unconscious students off the dance floor one by one… Once all the students were saved, the equipment struck the final note on its keyboard with force, emitted a burst of electrical static, and scattered across the ground, returning Clement Music Corner to hushed silence.
"Phew… What a troublesome Anomaly. I need to get these students to the hospital… Huh?!"
The crowd burst into applause and cheers. Mint looked up and realized the performance plaza was already packed with an audience.
"Not a single miss! That was amazing…"
"Can you do that again? I didn't get the whole thing on video!"
"That song sounds so familiar… Could it be that genius DJ?!"
…
The security guard smiled unconsciously among the cheering crowd and began clapping along.
It had been so long since things were this lively.

Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly consists of a set of electronic music production and performance equipment. This equipment can operate without being plugged in and can combine into specific forms to move autonomously.
· This Anomaly has states similar to being deactivated and activated. When deactivated, it appears as equipment lying on the plaza; once activated, the Anomaly will float and move autonomously, challenging people in the plaza.
· When a challenge starts, this Anomaly will play electronic music and form fluorescent projections indicating the volume within the plaza. The reason it initiates challenges has not yet been determined, but it is confirmed that the Anomaly attacks according to the music's rhythm, forcing the challenged party to move to the beat. If the challenged party makes a mistake, they will be hit by a powerful sound wave attack, which can cause unconsciousness in severe cases.
· This Anomaly is suspected to possess the ability to compose music autonomously. Its musical compositions have attracted the attention and love of many citizens.

Anomaly Nexus
Within its performance area, move according to the rhythm and attack in-between to defeat it.

Risk Assessment
Moderate hazard.
