Desc.SourceString:
【异象故事】
你和你的同类被人类发明了。人类说你是他们最伟大的发明，将你制造成各种形态送入千家万户。然而很多很多年后，他们又说你是人类最糟糕的发明，你污染了世界，你应该从这个世界上消失。
你知道确实有很多同类在海洋里制造巨大的麻烦，可毕竟现在你只是一个小小的，安静的，蓝色的，塑料盆。
你对扣歪的帽子感到愤怒，想看看现在海洋里究竟是什么模样。你不知道自己身为一个异常的塑料盆，所链接到的是另一片虚空的海洋。
——所以这是个愤怒的塑料盆？
——更正，是愤怒却不知道怎么表达的塑料盆。不过我觉得它已经没那么愤怒了，现在它被当成宝贝供着，成队的人等着借助这盆里的倒影给自己指点迷津。它不再是「糟糕污染物」中的一员了。
——所以，这个盆链接着的，其实是那个……
——是的，那个地方……还是不要写在档案里了。

【异象特性】
·在不装水时，与普通脸盆无异。
·装入水后，若观察自己在水面中的倒影，则会在其中看到一段关于自身的奇特影像，包括但不限于幻想、未来等。目前该影像内容尚无准确定义。
·每个个体仅能看到一次奇特影像。第二次及以后的观察中，只会见到普通倒影。
·对人类以外的生物不适用。
·暂未观察到该塑料脸盆的老化现象。

【异象奇点】
将该异象装入塑料袋后，会自行泯除。一段时间后重新出现在上次泯除地点附近。

【风险评估】
无害，但由于其特殊性质，需要持续保持观察。

【收容/担保情况】
目前为私人所有物。

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
实验①
在盆中倒入各种液体，无论液体种类、颜色、密度如何，均能观察到影像。
由于在此实验中，全部成员均已观察过影像，无法继续测试，故实验暂停。

【衍生异象】
/

【延展信息】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
Anomaly Story
You and your kind were invented by humans. Humans said you were their greatest invention, manufacturing you in all shapes and forms to send into every household… Yet many, many years later, they declared that you were humanity's worst invention. You polluted the world. You should disappear from this planet.
You know that many of your kind are indeed causing enormous trouble in the oceans, but after all, right now you are just a small, quiet, blue, plastic basin…
You feel angry about being blamed for things you did not do, and want to see what the oceans really look like now. You don't realize that as an anomalous plastic basin, you are connected to a different ocean, one residing in the void…
"So this is an angry plastic basin?"
"Correction: an angry plastic basin that does not know how to express itself, though I think it might not be so angry anymore. Now it is treated like a treasure, with lines of people waiting to borrow the reflections in this basin to find guidance. It is no longer one of those pollutants."
"So, what this basin is connected to is actually that…"
"Yes, that place… Let us not put it in the profile."

Anomaly Characteristics
· When not filled with water, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary washbasin.
· When filled with water, if one observes their own reflection on the water's surface, they will see a strange vision about themselves, including but not limited to fantasies, futures, etc. The content and accuracy of these visions has not yet been accurately determined.
· Each individual can only see a strange vision once. On any subsequent observations, they will only see a normal reflection.
· Does not apply to living things other than humans.
· No aging phenomena have been observed in this plastic washbasin so far.

Anomaly Nexus
When this Anomaly is placed into a plastic bag, it will undergo nullification on its own. After a period, it will reappear near the location of its last nullification.

Risk Assessment
Harmless, but due to its special properties, continuous observation is required.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Currently privately owned.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
Experiment 1
Various liquids were poured into the basin. Regardless of the type, color, or density of the liquid, visions could be observed.
Since all members involved in this experiment have already observed the visions, further testing cannot continue. Experiment suspended.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/

Desc.SourceString:
「F*d=OPEN!」

【异象故事】
在某个研究设施中，一次收容事故导致设施被封闭。整座设施的能源、水源都被完全切断，而突破收容的异象阻碍着救援队伍的进入。长此以往，设施里的科研团队将遭受重大损失。此时，科研团队中的一位博士拿起了工具箱中不起眼的撬棍，开始了他的史诗壮举：他先是撬开了通风管道，然后撬开了封闭的实验室大门，接着撬开了基地的安全通道，最后甚至撬开了整个异象空间——天知道他是怎么做到的！他的壮举让救援团队得以进入，重新收容了解离的异象，拯救了科研团队。但是在这件事情后，这位博士却神秘消失了，更奇怪的是，他的同事们都忘记了他的相貌和名字，设施的人员名册更是查无此人。而也就是在他失踪之后，异象「撬撬」开始出现……

T-0847[Ob]撬撬，外观是一根朴实无华的……撬棍。就是那种你可以从任何一个工具箱里摸出来的撬棍。作为异象，它的能力，也是它的本能，就是「开启」。只要撬撬存在，它就会不断尝试撬开周围一切「封锁的」物体，不管是手提箱、保险柜，还是异象收容单元，只要给它足够多的时间，它都能打开。当它开启周围物体的行为被人发现时，它就会变得极具攻击性，开始攻击目击者，但是其攻击的强度与普通的撬棍并无差异，虽然挨打会很痛，但不致命。击败撬撬，阻止它继续开启周围的物体，撬撬就会泯除。

我宁可相信那位「自由人博士」只是群体臆想的产物，毕竟怎么可能有人只靠一根撬棍打穿整个异象空间呢？但是零星的档案记录却证实了，这件事情是真实发生过的。那位传奇博士手中的传奇撬棍为科研团队开辟了生路，而撬撬却并不关心行为背后的意义，只保留了那种对「开启」一事的紧迫感和执念。

【异象特性】
·外观为部分喷涂红漆的金属撬棍，漂浮在距离地面约一米的高度。
·该异象会不断「开启」周围一定范围内「封锁的」物体。
·「开启」行为被目击后，该异象会攻击目击者，攻击强度与普通撬棍无异。

【异象奇点】
目击该异象的「开启」行为后将其打败，阻止其「开启」意图。

【风险评估】
低危害性。

【收容/担保情况】
不允许私人担保。塞拉伊诺馆内有少量收容。

【收容措施】
将其与被锁住的物体一同收容。塞拉伊诺馆为收容撬撬准备了一种「自锁装置」，被开启后一段时间会自动恢复上锁状态。注意，须时刻保持该装置能源充足，否则极可能引发连锁收容事故！

【实验记录】
《关于异象「撬撬」性能的实验》
实验1：将撬撬分别与普通包装盒、简单密码锁、金库保险箱共同放置。
实验结论：撬撬打开不同物体的耗时存在显著差异，越复杂的闭锁装置，开启的耗时越长。

实验2：将撬撬收容于一个标准收容单元中。
实验结论：撬撬在大约15小时后自行开启了收容单元，且对收容单元结构造成了破坏。

实验3：将撬撬收容于一个标准收容单元中，并放入「自锁装置」。
实验结论：「自锁装置」的开启耗时长于其自锁的时间间隔，该收容措施有效。

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"F times D equals OPEN!"

Anomaly Story
At a certain research facility, a containment breach caused the entire facility to go into lockdown. All power and water to the entire facility were completely cut off, and the Anomaly that had breached containment blocked rescue teams from entering. If this continued, the research team inside would suffer significant losses… At that moment, one of the researcher team's doctors picked up an unremarkable crowbar from a toolbox and began his story: First, he pried open the vents. Then he pried open the sealed laboratory doors. Next, he pried open the facility's security passages. And finally, he even pried open the entire realm itself… Heaven knows how he managed that! His heroic actions allowed the rescue team to enter, re-contain the breached Anomaly, and save the research team. Strangely, after this incident, the savior mysteriously vanished! Even more odd, his colleagues forgot what he looked like and what his name was, and the facility's personnel roster showed no record of him ever existing. And it was after his disappearance that the Anomaly "Picky" began to appear…

T-0847(Ob) Picky. Its appearance is that of a plain, unremarkable… crowbar. The kind you could pull out of any toolbox. As an Anomaly, its ability and instinct are to "open." As long as Picky exists, it will continuously attempt to pry open anything "locked" around it, whether it be a suitcase, a safe, or an Anomaly containment unit. Given enough leverage, it can pry open anything. When someone witnesses it opening objects around it, it becomes extremely aggressive and begins attacking the witness, though its strength is no different from an ordinary crowbar. Getting hit will hurt, but it is not lethal. Defeat Picky and stop it from continuing to open objects around it, and Picky will undergo nullification.

I would rather believe that this "Dr. Freeman" was merely a product of collective imagination. After all, how could anyone possibly break through an entire realm with just a crowbar? But scattered records confirm that this actually happened, and the legendary crowbar in the legendary doctor's hands carved out a path to survival for the research team. Picky, however, does not care about the meaning behind actions. It only retains that sense of urgency and obsession with opening things.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a metal crowbar partially painted red, floating at approximately one meter above the ground.
· This Anomaly will continuously "open" any "locked" objects within a certain range.
· After its "opening" behavior is witnessed, this Anomaly will attack the witness. Its strength is no different from an ordinary crowbar.

Anomaly Nexus
After witnessing this Anomaly's "opening" behavior, defeat it to stop its intent to "open."

Risk Assessment
Low hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Private guarantee not permitted. A small number are contained within the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
Contain it together with locked objects. The Celaeno Compound has prepared a "self-locking device" for containing Picky, which automatically returns to a locked state a period after being opened. Note: This device must be kept fully powered at alls, otherwise it may trigger a chain containment breach!

Experiment Records
Experiment on the Performance of Anomaly Picky
Experiment 1: Picky was placed together with a cardboard box, a simple combination lock, and a vault safe, respectively.
Conclusion: There was a significant difference in the time Picky took to open different objects. The more complex the locking mechanism, the longer it took to open.

Experiment 2: Picky was contained in a standard containment unit.
Conclusion: Picky opened the containment unit on its own after approximately 15 hours, and caused structural damage to the containment unit.

Experiment 3: Picky was contained in a standard containment unit along with a self-locking device.
Conclusion: The required time to open the self-locking device is longer than its self-locking interval. This containment measure is effective.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
「故乡是我们力量的根源。」

【异象故事】
很久很久以前，一位伯爵为了享尽世上荣华富贵，与魔鬼签订契约，成为了吸食人类血液从而永葆青春的吸血鬼——作为代价，他将永远无法离开自己的领地。这位伯爵很快厌倦了土地上熟悉的花草树木、鸟兽鱼虫，甚至连战战兢兢的领民献上的血液都觉得难以下咽。他想到了一个办法，用他领地的泥土制造了一座完美的微缩城堡模型，再用魔法将自己缩小住进微缩城堡里。这样，只要他带着自己的「城堡」，就能四处旅行了。四百年后，他遇到了一名美丽的女士……
这些传说故事当然是后人编造的，但作为这一传说根源的城堡——「好客屋」，却是真实存在的。关于「好客屋」的记载和关于它的传说都由来已久，极少有异象能在这么长的时间跨度中始终存在，未被泯除。「好客屋」的起源已经无法考据，它不断在收藏家手中流转，而目前属于古董店「伊波恩」的藏品。

「好客屋」的外形看起来是一座微缩的城堡模型，其内部装潢精美、家具齐备，不考虑尺寸，几乎就是一座可以正常居住的城堡。「好客屋」的外形和装潢会随着时代的发展产生些微变化，这使得我们无法从建筑设计和内部装饰风格推测其形成的时代。现如今的「好客屋」，内部拥有完善的水电照明设施供进入其中的「客人」自由使用，但这些设施是如何在没有管线供应的情况下正常运作，仍然是未解之谜。
打开「好客屋」的大门后，周围一定范围内的人类（以及某些歧骸）会被好客屋视作「客人」，「客人」会被缩小到与「好客屋」相符的尺寸，并能够暂时进入「好客屋」进行参观。在此过程中，「客人」的随身物品也会与客人一同缩小，并且仍能正常工作。缩小效果持续7分钟，7分钟后「客人」会被传送到「好客屋」外并恢复原样。再次打开「好客屋」的大门可以再次入内参观，但每次都只有7分钟——这让许多希望借助「好客屋」内部环境拍摄影片的导演叫苦不迭。
「好客屋」的缩小时限，对它认定的「主人」和「敌人」并不适用，上述个体缩小后不会自动复原，复原方法只有「主人」知晓。好客屋的坚固程度与一座真正的城堡无异，这使得毫无威胁的好客屋可以在必要的时候保护自己的「主人」或者困住「敌人」。曾经有窃贼误触了「好客屋」的门，结果一整晚都处在缩小状态，最后向「好客屋」当时的「主人」发誓痛改前非，才得以变回原样。

「好客屋」长期存在而从未泯除，使得一些学者产生了好奇：它的奇点是什么？有一种观点从传说出发，认为「好客屋」的奇点是「故乡」——它最初诞生的地方。虽然无法考证，但「好客屋」的「故乡」大概是仍然存在的聚落，直到那里毁灭之前，「好客屋」都会一直存在。这也解释了为什么「好客屋」的装潢和设施与时俱进，故乡的发展在「好客屋」身上得到了体现，它也乐于向参观者展示自己故乡的进步。
这一观点尚未得到证实，但在笔者看来颇为浪漫。对于一个传说众多而又安全无害的异象而言，保持它的神秘感、给人们留足想象的空间，或许才是最好的结果。

【异象特性】
·外观为一座精美的微缩城堡模型。
·打开「好客屋」大门后，周围一定范围内的人类（以及某些歧骸）会被「好客屋」视作「客人」，缩小到能够进入城堡参观的尺寸。
·缩小效果持续7分钟，演奏「好客屋」内的管风琴可以提前结束参观恢复原样。
·「好客屋」认定的「主人」和「敌人」不受7分钟时间限制，恢复原样的方法只有「好客屋」的「主人」知道。

【异象奇点】
未知

【风险评估】
无害。

【收容/担保情况】
鉴于「好客屋」不会自主移动且无危害性，评估后决定不进行收容，目前由伊波恩古董店收藏。

【收容措施】
无需特殊收容措施。

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Home is the source of our strength."

Anomaly Story
Long, long ago, a count signed a contract with the devil, gaining all the world's riches and glory, and in exchange becoming a vampire who sustained eternal youth by drinking human blood. As the price, he could never leave his own domain. The count soon grew weary of the familiar flora and fauna, birds and beasts, fish and insects on his land. Even the blood offered by his trembling subjects became difficult to swallow down. He devised a solution: using soil from his domain, he crafted a perfect miniature castle model, then used magic to shrink himself down and live inside it. This way, as long as he carried his "castle" with him, he could venture anywhere beyond the walls he had long been confined to. Four hundred years later, he chanced upon a beautiful lady…
These Legendary tales are of course fabricated by later generations, but the castle at the root of this legend, the "Hospitable House," does exist. Records and legends about the "Hospitable House" date back centuries. Very few Anomalies can persist across such a long span of time without undergoing nullification. The origins of the "Hospitable House" can no longer be traced. It has continuously changed hands among collectors, and currently belongs to the collection of the antique shop "Eibon."

The Hospitable House appears to be a miniature castle model. Its interior is exquisitely decorated with complete sets of furniture. Setting aside its size, it is practically a fully livable castle. The appearance and decor of the Hospitable House change slightly with the times, making it impossible to deduce its era of origin from its architectural design or interior decoration style. Today's Hospitable House has complete water, electricity, and lighting facilities for "guests" who enter to use freely. How these facilities operate without any actual utility connections remains an unsolved mystery.
After opening the door to the Hospitable House, humans within a certain range (as well as certain Oddities) are recognized as "guests" by the Hospitable House. "Guests" are shrunk to a size matching the Hospitable House and can temporarily enter for a tour. During this process, the guests' personal items are also shrunk along with them and continue to function normally. The shrinking effect lasts for 7 minutes, after which "guests" are teleported outside the Hospitable House and restored to their original size. Opening the door again allows another tour, but each visit is limited to 7 minutes. This has caused no end of frustration for directors hoping to use the Hospitable House's interior for filming.
The shrinking limit does not apply to those the Hospitable House recognizes as "masters" or "enemies." These individuals do not automatically return to normal size after shrinking, and only the "master" knows how to restore them. The Hospitable House is as sturdy as a real castle, allowing this otherwise harmless Anomaly to protect its "master" or trap "enemies" when necessary. Once, a thief accidentally touched the door of the Hospitable House and remained shrunk for an entire night. Only after swearing to the Hospitable House's "master" that he would turn over a new leaf, he was restored to his original size.

The Hospitable House's long existence without nullification has piqued the curiosity of some scholars: what is its Nexus? One theory, drawing from the legend, suggests that the Hospitable House's Nexus is its "homeland," the place where it was first born. Though unverifiable, the Hospitable House's "homeland" is likely a settlement that still exists. Until that place is destroyed, the Hospitable House will continue to exist. This also explains why the Hospitable House's decor and facilities keep up with the times. The development of its homeland is reflected in the Hospitable House, and it delights in showing visitors the progress of its hometown.
This theory has not been confirmed, but in this writer's opinion, it is quite romantic. For an Anomaly with many legends that is safe and harmless, maintaining its mystique and leaving room for imagination may be the best outcome.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as an exquisite miniature castle model.
· After opening the door to the Hospitable House, humans within a certain range (as well as certain Oddities) are recognized as "guests" by the Hospitable House and shrunk to a size that allows them to tour the castle.
· The shrinking effect lasts for 7 minutes. Playing the pipe organ inside the Hospitable House can end the tour early and restore visitors to their original size.
· The 7-minute time limit does not apply to those the Hospitable House recognizes as "masters" or "enemies." Only the "master" of the Hospitable House knows how to restore them.

Anomaly Nexus
Unknown

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Given that the Hospitable House does not move on its own and poses no danger, it was decided after evaluation not to contain it. Currently part of the Eibon Antique Shop Collection.

Containment Measures
No special containment measures required.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Desc.SourceString:
「就在此处……艺术的幽灵。」

【异象故事】
T-1881[Ob]瑰夜魅影是一种偶尔出没于音乐厅、剧院或电影院这样的演艺场所的异象。其外观为黑白配色晚礼服，女款与男款会成对出现，虽然无人穿着，却漂浮在半空中翩翩起舞。由于瑰夜魅影会被盛大的演出所吸引，并伴随演出的结束而自然泯除，这种异象时常被认为无害。但是，干扰演出，又或者试图中止瑰夜魅影舞步的举动，都会遭到该异象的反击。攻击时，该异象的舞步会化作它们的武器，对熟练的异象猎人而言威胁性不高。但是，瑰夜魅影往往成群结队出现，这会使得它们的危险性大大提高。
有些艺术家将瑰夜魅影的出现视作成功的标志——这种想法倒也不能说是错的，毕竟这些家伙的品味其实还挺挑剔的。不过考虑到它们对一般人的危险性，还是在发现的第一时间通知异象管理局比较好吧？

【异象特性】
·会被盛大的演出所吸引，以「舞步」攻击试图中止演出的人。

【异象奇点】
吸引它们的演出结束，又或者舞步被外力打乱。

【风险评估】
低危害。成群出现时，危害性可能提升至中等。

【收容/担保情况】
塞拉伊诺馆有少量收容。

【收容措施】
收容单元内应保证足够起舞的空间。由于该异象会在吸引它们的演出结束时自然泯除，收容单元内以大屏幕不间断播放曾吸引过瑰夜魅影的经典演出节目，并确保播放的片单随其出现记录更新。

Desc.LocalizedString:
"Right here… the Ghost of art."

Anomaly Story
T-1881(Ob) Scarlet Phantom is an Anomaly that occasionally appears in performance venues such as concert halls, theaters, or cinemas. It takes the form of evening gowns in black and white, with female and male styles appearing in pairs. Though no one wears them, they float in midair, dancing gracefully together. Since Scarlet Phantoms are drawn to grand performances and naturally undergo nullification when the performance ends, they are often considered harmless. However, any attempt to disrupt the performance or stop the Scarlet Phantom's dance will provoke retaliation. When attacking, the Anomaly transforms dance steps into attacks. Though not particularly threatening to experienced Anomaly Hunters, Scarlet Phantoms often appear in groups, which significantly increases their danger level.
Some artists consider the appearance of Scarlet Phantoms a sign of success. This notion is not entirely wrong, as these entities are actually quite picky about their tastes. However, given the danger they pose to ordinary people, it would be best to notify the Bureau of Anomaly Control as soon as they are spotted, wouldn't it?

Anomaly Characteristics
· Drawn to grand performances; Attacks anyone who attempts to stop the performance using their dance.

Anomaly Nexus
The performance that drew them ends, or their dance disrupted by external force.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. When appearing in groups, hazard level may increase to moderate.

Containment/Guarantee Status
A small number are contained at the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
The containment unit should provide sufficient space for dancing. Since this Anomaly naturally undergoes nullification when the performance that attracted them ends, a large screen continuously playing classic performances that have previously attracted Scarlet Phantoms is sufficient. The playlist should be updated according to their appearance records.

Desc.SourceString:
开的「胶片」包裹，向外延展的「胶片」飘荡在核心周围，呈现出腕足状。
该异象的主要能力为「定格」和「复现」。「定格」能力可以「拍摄」物品将其变成照片，或者「拍摄」人类，使其虚弱并将其拖入自身形成的空间异常内。「复现」可以使胶片相机拍摄过的场景、物体、歧骸甚至人物以复制体的形式出现在「胶卷-MANISH」形成的空间异常内。关于其特性的更多细节，详见报告书附件1。

在胶片摄影的时代，胶片呈现出的独特质感和色调，使得「胶卷」风靡一时。但是胶片摄影技术并不是谁都能轻松掌握的——从拍摄时的快门速度，到显影和定影时的试剂调配，再到最后的后期修整，摄影水平在每一个环节上都有显而易见的呈现。而提到胶片摄影，就不得不提到「暗室」，一处能够隔绝光线、保护珍贵的胶卷不受过度曝光影响，方便冲洗和进行其他处理的房间。
黑暗的光线，大小不一的瓶瓶罐罐，多种神秘的试剂……这样让人联想到巫术和炼金术的神秘「暗室」，在「菲林轨迹」中就有一间。在照相馆开业初期，胶片摄影仍然是主流，店主正是靠着优秀的胶片摄影技术吸引了第一批客户。但不久之后，数码摄影开始冲击市场，便携、易用、高容错的数码相机很快取代了胶片相机成为主流。客流量带来的工期压力、修图软件的逐步普及，加上对人工成本与操作难度的综合考量，使得「菲林轨迹」在不久之后以数码摄影全面替代了胶片摄影。那时还未成为异象的「胶卷」自此被放入仓库角落不见天日，暗室也从此停止使用。此后一天、一月、一年……再也无人想起「胶卷」的存在。
「胶卷」不愿意被遗忘，不愿那些它记录过的光影与色彩同它一起蒙尘。再后来，「胶卷」成为了「胶卷-MANISH」，以这种方式继续履行它作为「摄影器材」的使命，用最肆无忌惮的方式展示了自己所「记录」的一切，直到最后被泯除。
……不过，在异象泯除后，店主似乎用再次使用胶片摄影技术拍摄了一组照片，赠予解决该事件的异象猎人，也算是满足了「胶卷」的心愿。向未来问好，与历史道别，我们的文明正是因此生生不息。

【异象特性】
《附件1：关于异象R-5791[Ob]特性的详细报告》
该异象的主要能力为「定格」和「复现」，在尚未接触其本体时，没有明显的使用规律。
使用「定格」时，被异象锁定的目标身后会凭空出现「镜头」并发出拍摄前的倒计时提示音，倒计时结束时，处于「镜头」拍摄范围内的对象会被「定格」。被「定格」的物品会变成一张照片，而人类则会在短暂失去行动能力后恢复，但也会感到明显的虚弱和不适，连续被「定格」可能会对人类造成不可逆的伤害。规避「定格」的方法很简单，在倒计时结束前离开「镜头」的拍摄范围即可。
「胶卷-MANISH」的「复现」能力，使其可以在自身影响范围内「复现」胶片相机曾经拍摄的事物，也包括其自身使用「定格」能力记录下来的那些。这一能力可以「复现」场景，生成光怪陆离的空间——有些情况下是色彩正常的「正片」，有些情况下则是色彩与现实相反的「负片」。有时，被该异象「定格」的生物，会被拖入异常空间内，大大增加了寻找该异象本体的难度。在「胶卷-MANISH」复现的空间内，还存在具有攻击性的伴生歧骸，可能也是曾经记录下的影像的一部分，必须警惕在场景发生变化后突然出现的伴生歧骸。
在接近「胶卷-MANISH」的本体后，该异象会使用包括撞击、下砸和用胶卷抽打在内的方式保护自身，同时也会使用「复现」能力复制出各种物品作为攻击手段。此时的「胶卷-MANISH」还会「复现」被「定格」过的人类帮助战斗，但这种方式似乎存在限制，复制体在场时，「胶卷-MANISH」的本体无法行动，而在复制体被击溃后，异象本体也会陷入虚弱状态。
「胶卷-MANISH」的能力影响范围局限在照相馆内，普通人遭遇时只要避免刺激异象，关注和躲避凭空出现的「镜头」，尽快离开影响范围，就可以保证自身安全。

【异象奇点】
征服其所「记录」的一切，直白地说——进入异象形成的异常空间并击败它。

【风险评估】
具有危害性，但风险可控。对存有胶片摄影设备而并未开展相关业务的照相馆，应进行额外的安全教育并提供异象应对指南。

Desc.LocalizedString:
An opened package of "film" with strips extending and drifting like tentacles around the core.
This anomaly's main abilities are freeze and replay. The first ability turns photographed objects into pictures, as well as weakens the humans it photographs and pulls them into a Space Anomaly. The second ability allows scenes, objects, oddities, and even characters Film - MANISH photographed to reappear as duplicates within its Space Anomaly. For more details about its characteristics, see Appendix 1.

Back in the days of film photography, film was popular due to its unique textures and color tones. However, the skills involved were not something just anyone could master. From shutter speed, mixing reagents, developing and fixing, to the final post-processing touches, one's skill level was evident at every stage. When it comes to film photography, one cannot overlook the darkroom that blocks out light, protects film rolls, and facilitates developing and processing.
At Film Orbit Studio was a mysterious dim room stacked with bottles and jars containing unknown reagents, reminiscent of witchcraft and alchemy. In the early days of the studio, film photography was still mainstream, and the owner attracted the first group of customers through excellent film photography skills. But digital photography soon began disrupting the market. Portable, user-friendly, and forgiving, digital cameras quickly replaced film cameras as the new standard. Pressure from increased customer traffic, progression in editing software, along with considerations of labor costs and technical challenges, Film Orbit Studio was compelled to completely shift to digital. One particular film roll, not yet an anomaly at that time, was placed in a corner of the warehouse, never to see the light of day. The darkroom was also abandoned. Days turned to months, months turned to years, but no one ever remembered the film roll.
The film roll did not want to be forgotten. It did not want the light, shadow, and colors it had captured to gather dust. At some point, the film roll became Film - MANISH, which continued to fulfill its mission as a photography equipment, displaying everything it captured in the most uninhibited manner, until its eventual nullification.
…However, after nullification, the owner used film photography techniques for another set of photos, which were given to the anomaly hunter responsible for resolving the incident. Some would say the film roll's wish came true. In the end, this case highlights how civilization thrives by welcoming the future and bidding farewell to the past.

[Characteristics]
Appendix 1: Detailed Report on the Characteristics of Anomaly R-5791[Ob]
This anomaly's main abilities are freeze and replay. Before encountering its main body, there are no obvious patterns for these abilities.
When using freeze, a camera lens appears behind the target and lets out a countdown sound before shooting. When the countdown ends, objects within the camera's range will be frozen and become photographs. After a period of time, humans regain mobility, though they will feel sick and weak. Consecutive freezing may cause irreversible harm. It's easy to avoid being frozen: stay out of the camera's range before the countdown ends.
Film - MANISH's second ability allows it to replay things previously photographed by film cameras within its influence, including those recorded by its own freeze ability. This second ability can replay scenes, often creating bizarre spaces. In some cases, these spaces appear as properly colored positives, while in others, they appear as negatives with colors inverted from reality. Sometimes, creatures frozen by this anomaly are dragged into an Anomalous Space, which also greatly increases the difficulty of locating the anomaly's main body. Within the space replayed by Film - MANISH comes with aggressive surge oddities, possibly from previously recorded images. One must be aware of such oddities when the scene suddenly changes.
After approaching Film - MANISH's main body, the anomaly will protect itself by ramming, slamming, and whipping enemies with film strips, as well as use its replay ability to unleash items it captured before. At this stage, Film - MANISH will also replay previously frozen humans to assist it. However, this method has limitations: while duplicates are present, Film - MANISH's main body cannot move. After duplicates are defeated, the anomaly's main body also enters a weakened state.
Film - MANISH's range of influence is limited to the photo studio. When common people encounter this anomaly, they can stay safe by refraining from provocation, and watch out for camera lenses that appear randomly, as well as leave the affected area as soon as they can.

[Anomaly Nexus]
Conquer everything it recorded—enter the Anomalous Space it forms and defeat it.

[Risk Assessment]
Hazardous but controllable. Studios with long-term unused film photography equipment should receive security training and follow additional anomaly response guidelines.

[Containment/Guarantee Status]
/

[Containment]

Desc.SourceString:
「灯火管制。」

【异象故事】
故事开始于一座废弃的古老城堡。已经没有人知晓其具体的历史，但是附近的村镇居民都声称那座城堡「闹鬼」，进入城堡的人，手中的光源都会不自然地熄灭，而在城堡的黑暗环境中时间太长，就会被鬼魂带走，再也回不来。这个传闻在小众灵异爱好者中流传，几个好事的年轻人聚集起来，前往城堡探险，却杳无音信、人间蒸发。他们的父母请来了一位擅长在黑暗中行动的异象猎人去城堡寻找失踪者，但那位异象猎人最终没有找到失踪者，只是带回了一切的罪魁祸首——一盏台灯。

异象U-2016[Ob]是一件台灯，我们称其为「关灯后」。其工艺有不同时代的痕迹，没有能源连接口，但是仍然可以点亮。在点亮时，其与普通台灯无异，但是在点亮一段时间后，就会逐渐闪烁并最终熄灭。此后，以其为中心的一定范围内，所有光源都会逐渐熄灭，并形成不自然的「黑暗区域」——这样的区域是它的异象空间。在黑暗区域内，所有的光源亮度都会受到极大的限制，并且会在段时间后熄灭。从黑暗区域外，则几乎完全看不清区域内的情况。人在进入黑暗区域后，会在自己无法察觉的情况下转变成一团模糊的「阴影」，只有重新开启关灯后，才能使周围重回光明，阴影也会复原成原本的人。但是，如果以黑影的状态在黑暗区域中停留太久，重新开启台灯、黑暗区域消失时，黑影也会一同消失——那些可怜人永远迷失在了属于阴影的国度中。

对黑暗的恐惧是我们的本能。对未知的好奇同样是我们的本能。不论是为了证明自己无所畏惧，又或是想要知道黑暗中到底隐藏了什么，我们总是受到本能驱使踏入黑暗中，而关灯后就像是顶着熄灭的发光器的鮟鱇鱼，蛰伏等待着下一批好奇的探险者。

【异象特性】
·外观为一盏普通的台灯。
·熄灭后，周围逐渐被黑暗吞噬，范围的光源逐个熄灭。
·在黑暗区域中的人会变成阴影，在点亮关灯后之后复原，但长时间处于阴影状态的人可能无法复原。

【异象奇点】
将台灯点亮。并非永久泯除手段，只能消除其影响——但除非惠比寿同意，我们也无法强制将其泯除。

【风险评估】
中等危害性。

【收容/担保情况】
由惠比寿拍卖行担保。

【收容措施】
保持对该异象的监控，在其开始闪烁时，立即拉动开关将其重新点亮。

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】

Desc.LocalizedString:
"Lights out."

Anomaly Story
The story begins in an abandoned ancient castle. No one knows its exact history anymore, but residents of the nearby villages all agree that the castle was "haunted." Light sources in the hands of anyone who entered would unnaturally extinguish, and those who remained in the castle's darkness for too long would be taken away by ghosts, never to return. This rumor spread among niche paranormal enthusiasts, and a group of curious young people gathered together to explore the castle, only to vanish without a trace… Their parents hired an Anomaly Hunter skilled at operating in darkness to search the castle for the missing persons, but in the end, that Anomaly Hunter never located the missing people. They only retrieved the culprit behind everything: a lamp.

Anomaly U-2016(Ob) is a lamp we call "After Lights Out." Its craftsmanship bears traces of different eras. It has no power cord, yet it can still be switched on. When illuminated, it appears no different from a common lamp. However, after being lit for a period, it gradually begins to flicker and eventually goes out. Afterward, within a certain radius centered on it, all light sources gradually extinguish, forming an unnatural "dark zone." Such a zone is its Anomalous Realm, within which, the brightness of all light sources is severely limited and will extinguish after a short time. From outside the dark zone, it is nearly impossible to see what is happening inside. After entering the dark zone, a person will unknowingly transform into a blurry "Shadow" creature. Only by relighting After Lights Out can the surroundings return to brightness and the Shadows be restored to their original human forms. However, if someone remains in Shadow form within the dark zone for too long, when the lamp is relit and the dark zone disappears, the Shadow will disappear along with it… Those poor souls are forever lost in the realm of Shadows.

Fear of the dark is instinctive, as is curiosity about the unknown. Whether to prove we are fearless or to discover what truly hides in the darkness, we are always driven by instinct to step into the dark. After Lights Out is like an anglerfish with an extinguished lure, lying in wait for the next batch of curious explorers…

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a Common lamp.
· After extinguishing, the surroundings are gradually devoured by darkness, and light sources within range go out one by one.
· People in the dark zone transform into Shadows, only being restored after After Lights Out is relit. Those who remain in Shadow form for too long may be unable to recover.

Anomaly Nexus
Light the lamp. This is not a permanent nullification method; it can only eliminate its effects. However, unless Ebisu agrees, we cannot forcibly nullify it.

Risk Assessment
Moderate hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Guaranteed by the Ebisu Auction House.

Containment Measures
Maintain surveillance on this Anomaly. When it begins to flicker, immediately pull the switch to relight it.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly

Desc.SourceString:
「复仇、复仇……桀桀桀！！！」

【异象故事】
童年玩伴异象「抱抱熊」无法接受孩子已经成长、不再需要自己或遗忘自己的事实，没有自然泯除而是转化成了一种更危险也更狡猾的异象——「桀桀熊」。
作为由「抱抱熊」衍生而出的分支异象，「桀桀熊」更加少见。
这类异象认为，被遗弃又忘掉的熊如果不为自己复仇的话，就是懦夫！毕竟小破孩们嘴上说着「最喜欢你了」，实际上过了一段时间就会把手上的东西扔一边。无论它做出多么无辜委屈的样子，都不会再被曾经的「伙伴」看一眼。既然如此——桀桀熊会用尽一切手段，让讨厌的小孩们好好品尝孤身一人的恐惧滋味。对方喜欢什么，便化作什么用以诱骗。对方恐惧什么，便让其见识什么……真是可怖。

【异象特性】
与「抱抱熊」的另一分支异象，憎恨着所有大人的「伤心英熊」不同——桀桀熊憎恨着所有的孩子。它们以容易受到孩子喜爱的毛绒玩具感的歧骸形象出现，将孩子们引入歧途，甚至毁灭他们。
以这种分支转化出来的童年玩伴异象极难对付。它们擅长表现得无害而惹人怜爱，每一只形象都会根据视作目标的孩子对症下药地改变，很多时候无法锁定该异象的真名。
拥有三种形态：
①用来诱骗的可爱形象（在每个孩子眼中的形象都不一样）
②在大人眼中的无害版（一个熊玩偶）
③本性暴露的邪恶版（撕开玩偶皮套钻出来的邪恶本体，融合不同物种的混沌异象）

【异象奇点】
找到当初忘记/遗弃它的孩子，让孩子向桀桀熊道歉。

【风险评估】
危险程度不可控，发现需尽快泯除。

【收容/担保情况】
暂未发现收容方法，不可被担保。

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
/

【衍生异象】
/
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Revenge, revenge… Teehee hee!!!"

Anomaly Story
The childhood companion Anomaly "Huggy Bear" could not accept the fact that its child had grown up and no longer needed it… or worse, had forgotten about it. Instead of naturally fading away through nullification, it transformed into a more dangerous and cunning Anomaly: the "Teehee Bear."
As a branching Anomaly derived from "Huggy Bear," the "Teehee Bear" is considerably rarer.
These anomalies believe that an abandoned and forgotten bear is a coward if it does not seek revenge! After all, those little brats say things like "I love you the most!" but after a period, they just toss whatever they have to the wayside… No matter how innocent or pitiful it looks, it will never receive another glance from its former "companion." As such, the Teehee Bear will use every means necessary to make those hateful children taste the terror of being utterly alone. Whatever the children love, it becomes to lure them in. Whatever the children fear, it makes them witness… Truly terrifying.

Anomaly Characteristics
Unlike "Saddy Teddy," another branching Anomaly of "Huggy Bear" that hates all adults, the Teehee Bear hates all children. They appear as plush toy Oddities that easily win children's affection, leading them astray and even destroying them.
Childhood companion anomalies that transform into this branch are extremely difficult to deal with. They excel at appearing harmless and endearing. Each one tailors its appearance to the specific child it targets, making it often impossible to identify the Anomaly's true name.
It possesses three forms:
(1) A cute appearance used for deception (appears different to each child)
(2) A harmless version seen by adults (a teddy bear plush)
(3) An evil version revealing its true nature (the malevolent core that tears through the plush exterior, a chaotic Anomaly fusing different species)

Anomaly Nexus
Find the child who originally forgot or abandoned it, and have the child apologize to the Teehee Bear.

Risk Assessment
Hazard level is uncontrollable. Nullification should be carried out as soon as possible upon discovery.

Containment/Guarantee Status
No Containment method has been discovered. Cannot be guaranteed.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly

Desc.SourceString:
「只要动动脑子就能创作，天底下还有这种好事！？」

【异象故事】
DSD潮玩推出的「异象制品」类潮玩，能够在塑形后根据塑造者的想法，呈现出木制、金属、宝石、瓷器等几乎所有能想到的材质，被广泛应用在居家装饰中。值得注意的是，随心泥不论被塑造成了什么材质，都只会改变其外观和触感，其物理性质仍然是一种软泥，在遇到极端温度、酸碱度或物理冲击时，随心泥会失去原有的形态，甚至逐渐失去异象特性。在上述条件下，或反复使用多次后，随心泥会失去异象特性并转化成类似普通软泥的材质，其成分是以淀粉为主的多种有机物，经检测对人体无害。

随心泥在被塑造成生物外观时，不会呈现出生物特性，但是会出现不稳定迹象，大多数时候会软化成原本的软泥形态，极少数未经验证的报告中称被塑造出的生物会拥有短时间的行动能力。出于人身安全和心理健康的考虑，不建议进行此类尝试。

【异象特性】
·可以按照使用者的想法呈现出各种颜色和材质。
·不论塑造出的材质如何，本质仍然是一种软泥，极端条件下会失去形状甚至失去异象特性。
·被塑造成生物外形时会出现不稳定迹象。

【异象奇点】
即使可以随心塑造各种材质，本质依然如同软泥一样柔软；在极端温度、极端酸碱度、反复使用次数过多时会逐渐失去特性，并最终转化成一种不具备异象特性的无害有机质软泥。

【风险评估】
由DSD潮玩担保，民间流通销售。

【收容/担保情况】
/

【收容措施】
/

【实验记录】
1、实验内容：将随心泥置入沸水中。
实验结果：随心泥立即融化。约5分钟后，随心泥失去异象特性，我们得到一碗粘稠的淀粉浓汤。
2、实验内容：将随心泥置入急冻环境中。
实验结果：约5分钟后取出时，随心泥已失去异象特性，变成一块淀粉砖块。
3、实验内容：将随心泥分别置于强酸溶液和强碱溶液中。
实验结果：接触瞬间，随心泥失去异象特性，残余有机物与溶液发生反应。
4、实验内容：使用高压将随心泥碾平。
实验结果：即使被碾压成薄片，随心泥仍然能够复原并保持异象特性。但在超过了某个临界点后，随心泥失去异象特性。
5、实验内容：使用搅拌机将随心泥打碎。
实验结果：随心泥捏合复原后能够保持异象特性。反复打碎一段时间后，随心泥的异象特性减弱，呈现出的材质变得不真实。继续打碎一段时间后，随心泥失去异象特性。

/

Desc.LocalizedString:
"Create anything just by thinking about it? Is there really such a good deal!?"

Anomaly Story
The Imaginadough is an Anomaly Product released by DSD POP. After being shaped, it can take on the appearance of nearly any material imaginable based on the creator's thoughts alone! These materials include wood, metal, gem, ceramic, and more. It is widely used in Home Decor. Notably, regardless of what material Imaginadough is shaped into, only its appearance and texture change, but its physical properties remain that of a soft dough. When exposed to extreme temperatures, pH levels, or physical impact, Imaginadough loses its form and may gradually lose its Anomaly characteristics. Under the aforementioned conditions, or after repeated use, Imaginadough loses its Anomaly characteristics and transforms into a substance similar to normal dough, composed mainly of starch and various organic compounds that are harmless to humans.

When Imaginadough is shaped into a Bio Appearance, it does not exhibit biological characteristics, but signs of instability appear. In most cases, it eventually softens back into its original dough form. In a few unverified reports, shaped creatures were said to possess brief mobility. For personal safety and mental health considerations, such attempts are not recommended.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Can take on various colors and materials according to the user's thoughts.
· Regardless of the material it is shaped into, it remains essentially a soft dough. Under extreme conditions, it will lose its shape or even its Anomaly characteristics.
· Shows signs of instability when shaped into a Bio Appearance.

Anomaly Nexus
Even though it can be freely shaped into various materials, its essence remains as soft as dough. Under extreme temperatures, extreme pH levels, or after excessive repeated use, it gradually loses its characteristics and ultimately transforms into a harmless organic dough without Anomaly characteristics.

Risk Assessment
Guaranteed by DSD POP. Sold in public circulation.

Containment/Guarantee Status
/

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
1. Experiment: Placing Imaginadough in boiling water.
Result: Imaginadough melted immediately. After approximately 5 minutes, it lost its Anomaly characteristics. We obtained a bowl of thick starch soup.
2. Experiment: Placing Imaginadough in a flash freezing environment.
Result: After approximately 5 minutes, Imaginadough had lost its Anomaly characteristics and became a normal block of starch.
3. Experiment: Placing Imaginadough in strong acid solution and strong alkaline solution respectively.
Result: Upon contact, Imaginadough lost its Anomaly characteristics. The remaining organic matter reacted with the solutions.
4. Experiment: Using high pressure to flatten Imaginadough.
Result: Even when flattened into a thin sheet, Imaginadough could still recover and maintain its Anomaly characteristics. After exceeding a certain threshold, however, it lost its Anomaly characteristics.
5. Experiment: Using a blender to break apart Imaginadough.
Result: After being kneaded back together, Imaginadough maintained its Anomaly characteristics. After repeated blending for a period, its Anomaly characteristics weakened and the materials it presented became unrealistic. After continued blending for another period, it lost its Anomaly characteristics.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info

Desc.SourceString:
【异象故事】
门关好了没有？灯关上了没有？水龙头拧紧了没有？这些问题在你走出家门三分钟后成堆地冒出来。你一遍遍确认回忆的细节，关于把手的转动、开关的触感，但回忆不完全可信，你希望跑回去重新确认一遍，才能真正安心。
这是一种强迫性怀疑，并不是所有人都受它困扰——这些人都是幸运儿。而受它困扰的，则一遍遍地受它折磨。门关好了吗？没关好怎么办？家里岂不是要遭偷窃？水龙头拧紧了没有？水龙头没关怎么办？水会一直流、一直流，直到淹没屋子，然后淹没楼道，接着是楼梯间、整栋房子……越来越灾难化的想象在头脑里蔓延，「没关的水龙头」就从这些臆想中诞生了。它是人们无因的恐惧，因此水流呈现为黑色，并且有时会化形为怪物——毕竟，灾难化的想象里怎么能没有怪物的存在呢？

【异象特性】
·具体表现为一个带有水龙头的洗手台，水龙头处于开启状态，黑色的水流不断从中流出。
·水龙头中流出的黑色水流不受重力影响，可以向各个方向漫延。多数情况下，这些水流不会直接漫延到现实世界，而是通过其他能够联通异象空间的方式扩散。
·黑色水流中，偶尔会出现极具攻击性的类生物个体。
·关闭水龙头后，整个洗手台及黑色水流会消失。

【异象奇点】
找到水龙头并将其关闭

【风险评估】
水流表现出攻击行为，威胁人身安全，需要及时泯除。

【收容/担保情况】
未收容

【收容措施】
/

Desc.LocalizedString:
Anomaly Story
Did I lock the door? Did I turn off the lights? Did I turn off the faucet? These questions pile up minutes after you leave home. You keep replaying the details in your memory: the twist of the handle, the feel of the switch… but memories aren't entirely reliable. You want to run back and check again, just to feel at ease.
This is a form of compulsive doubt, and only a lucky few aren't troubled by it. Those who are, however, are tormented by it again and again. Did I lock the door? What if I didn't? Won't my home get robbed? Did I turn off the faucet? What if I didn't? The water will keep flowing and flowing until it floods the room, then the hallway, then the stairwell, then the entire building… These increasingly catastrophic imaginings spread through the mind, and from them, the "Faucet Left Running" was born. It is the embodiment of baseless fear, thus, the water that flows out appears dark and muddy, sometimes takes the form of monsters. After all, how could catastrophic imaginings exist without monsters?

Anomaly Characteristics
· Manifests as a sink with a faucet. The faucet is in the open position, with dark water continuously flowing from it.
· The dark water flowing from the faucet is not affected by gravity and can spread in any direction. In most cases, the water does not spread directly into the real world, but expands through other means that connect to the Anomalous Realm.
· Occasionally, highly aggressive entities appear within the dark water.
· Once the faucet is turned off, the sink and water will disappear.

Anomaly Nexus
Find the faucet, turn it off.

Risk Assessment
The water exhibits aggressive behavior and is a threat. Prompt nullification is required.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not contained.

/

Experiment Records

Desc.SourceString:
「倾世之雨，来自世界表皮上的一道创伤。」

【异象故事】
「极漩」是突然出现在新西里安市的高危异象，归档编号为N-0824[Ph]。极漩的出现和泯除都十分迅速，却在极短的时间里造成了严重的破坏，几乎摧毁了新西里安受影响的全部区域，造成的人员和财产损失不计其数。

极漩的可以分为三个部分：「雨云」、「光环」和「核心」。目前，我们无法确认极漩的出现形成了雨云，还是极漩出现在了雨云之中，但事发时云层的遮盖是新西里安事件中，没能及时发出预警的原因之一。在极漩的影响下，雨云形成的降雨会导致降雨区域内的物理规律陷入紊乱。雨水会侵蚀接触到的物质结构，而接触到雨水的生物，则会失去身体的控制权，无法控制地望向天空。J.T.F装备的，包括「黑盒面罩」在内的防护装备，能够一定程度上抵御雨水侵蚀，但不能完全隔绝影响。
受到雨水影响看向天空的人，会不可避免地看到极漩的「光环」，而很遗憾……事情到了这一步就已经无法挽回。直视光环会瞬间摧毁普通人的心智，极漩泯除后救援队从新西里安的废墟中救出来的人中，许多人已经发生脑死亡或成为了植物人，症状较轻的也有严重的认知紊乱、失忆或其他创伤后症状。幸运地避开了雨水且没有直视光环的幸存者，大多数没有受到极漩的直接伤害。根据参加救援行动的异能者反馈，异能者可以短时间直视光环而不受严重伤害，但只会看到大量光怪陆离的混乱画面，并体验到极大的痛苦——仿佛精神被人撕扯一样的痛苦。
非常讽刺的是，这「不可直视的异象」，奇点却意外的脆弱。极漩自出现就开始自然泯除，而目视其核心会大大加快泯除进程——非常奇怪的是，目视极漩核心是无害的。极漩的「核心」位于重重光环和厚重雨云保护之下，核心没有一个可被描述的物理形态，只有「■■■■■」和「■■」真正目睹了极漩的核心。按照目击者口述，那看起来像是一道「裂缝」，甚至是「伤口」。从裂缝中溢出的「错误信息」，与现实世界的物理规律以及人们的常规认知发生冲突，才产生了包括雨云和光环在内的现象。
极漩泯除后，其造成的损害并未随之消除，次生灾害的危险性也不可小觑。以「原核体」为主的伴生异象在极漩的影响范围内大量出现，攻击周围的一切，即使在极漩泯除后，这些伴生异象也并未随之消除。与一开始的预测相反，极漩泯除后留下的不仅仅是断壁残垣的废墟。悬浮的建筑、逆生的树木、仿佛缓慢生长的钢筋枝桠……这座城市呈现出一种异化的「繁荣」姿态，却不再适合人类居住。如何清理废墟、重建城市，不仅需要详尽的方案，更需要花费巨大的人力物力。

极漩的目击者众多，但其中大多数人都只看见了光环，就算侥幸生还，我们也无法问出有用的信息。研究者事后根据其核心的性质推测，极漩的本质是我们世界之外的某个……空间？区域？还是别的什么……总之，它与我们的世界产生了交汇。那个世界的运行逻辑与我们完全不同，泄露出来的「错误信息」引发的冲突导致了后来发生的一切。我们对那个世界知之甚少，但这或许是种幸运——直视那个世界可能会烧坏我的脑子。极漩的出现在「环」的内部也引发了一些风波，不过那些倒是与极漩本身无关。
在这次异象灾害中，我们也并非全无所获，我们发现了……权限不足，暂无法查阅。

【异象特性】
·分为「雨云」、「光环」和「核心」三个部分；
·雨云降下的雨水会改变物理规律，侵蚀物质结构，并导致接触雨水的人抬头看向极漩；
·目视光环的人会受到严重的精神伤害，异能者具有更好的抵御能力但并非免疫；
·核心是没有可被描述物理形态的裂缝，目视核心将导致极漩泯除进程加速。

【异象奇点】
「核心」被人直视。

【风险评估】
极高危害性，具有摧毁整座城市的可能性。

【收容/担保情况】
唯一已知个体已经泯除，未进行收容。

【收容措施】
/

/

【衍生异象】

Desc.LocalizedString:
"A rain to end the world, flowing from a wound upon reality's skin."

Anomaly Story
The Hypervortex is a highly dangerous Anomaly that suddenly appeared in New Helios, archived under number N-0824(Ph). The Hypervortex appeared and underwent nullification very quickly, yet in that brief window, it caused devastating destruction, nearly obliterating all affected areas of New Helios and resulting in countless casualties and property losses.

The Hypervortex can be divided into three parts: the storm, the halo, and the core. Currently, we cannot confirm whether the Hypervortex's appearance created the storm, or whether it emerged from within the storm. The thick clouds during the New Helios incident was one of the reasons early warnings were not issued. Under the Hypervortex's influence, precipitation from the storm cloud causes physical laws within the rainfall area to fall into chaos. The rain erodes the material structure of anything it touches, and organisms that come into contact with the rain lose control of their bodies, compulsively staring up at the sky. Protective equipment used by JTF, including the Black Box Mask, can resist rain erosion to some degree, but cannot completely block its effects.
Those who look up at the sky under the rain's influence will inevitably see the Hypervortex's halo, and unfortunately… by that point, there is no turning back. Directly viewing the halo instantly destroys the minds of ordinary people. Of those rescued from the ruins of New Helios after the Hypervortex's nullification, many had suffered brain death or become vegetative. Those with milder symptoms still had severe cognitive disorders, amnesia, or other post-traumatic conditions. Survivors who were fortunate enough to avoid the rain and did not directly look at the halo mostly escaped direct harm from the Hypervortex. According to feedback from Espers who participated in rescue operations, Espers can briefly look at the halo without serious injury, but will only see chaotic, bizarre images and experience tremendous pain, as if their minds were being torn apart.
Ironically, despite being an Anomaly that "cannot be looked at," its Nexus is surprisingly fragile. The Hypervortex began undergoing natural nullification from the moment it appeared, and directly looking at its core greatly accelerates the nullification process. Strangely, looking at the Hypervortex's core is harmless. The core is protected by layers of halos and thick storm clouds. The core has no describable physical form. Only "■■■■■" and "■■" truly witnessed the Hypervortex's core. According to eyewitness accounts, it looked like a "rift," or even a "wound." The erroneous info overflowing from the rift conflicted with the physical laws of reality and common sense, thus producing the phenomena including the storm and the halo.
After the Hypervortex's nullification, the damage it caused did not disappear, and the danger of secondary disasters cannot be underestimated. Surge Anomalies, primarily Protocores, appeared in large numbers within the Hypervortex's area of influence, attacking everything around them. Even after the Hypervortex's nullification, these Surge Anomalies did not vanish. Contrary to initial predictions, the Hypervortex's nullification left behind more than just ruins and rubble. Floating buildings, trees growing in reverse, steel reinforcement bars slowly branching like limbs… The city displays a twisted form of "prosperity," yet is no longer suitable for human habitation. There are detailed plans on clearing the ruins and rebuilding the city, with enormous workforces and resources being committed to the cause.

There were many witnesses to the Hypervortex, but most of them only saw the halo. Even if they were lucky enough to survive, we cannot extract useful information from them. Researchers later speculated based on the core's nature that the Hypervortex is essentially some kind of… space, region, or something similar, originating from outside our world, which intersected with ours. That world operates on a completely different logic, and the conflict caused by the leaked erroneous info led to everything that followed. We know very little about that world, but this may be fortunate. Directly viewing that world would probably fry my brain. The Hypervortex's appearance also caused some disturbances within the Circle, though those were unrelated to the Hypervortex itself.
In this Anomaly disaster, we did not come away empty-handed. We discovered… Insufficient clearance. Unable to access.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Divided into three parts: storm, halo, and core.
· Rain from the storm cloud alters physical laws, erodes material structures, and causes those who contact the rain to look up at the Hypervortex.
· Those who look at the halo suffer severe mental damage. Espers have better resistance but are not immune to it.
· The core is a rift with no describable physical form. Looking at the core accelerates the Hypervortex's nullification process.

Anomaly Nexus
The core being directly observed by someone.

Risk Assessment
Extremely high hazard. Has the potential to destroy an entire city.

Containment/Guarantee Status
The only known individual has been nullified. No containment was performed.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Desc.SourceString:
【异象故事】
试想一下，一群人面无表情地升天或落地，听起来诡异又好笑，对吧？但这就是所有的升降直梯里正在发生的事。
最早的电梯并没有那么封闭，我们能从内部看到楼层之间的缝隙。后来为了安全或者管他什么原因，电梯成了全封闭的，开门，人走进去，关门，再开门时门外已经成了别的模样。对电梯里的人来说，门关上后，外界就变成了完全的未知。
大部分人信任电梯，相信这台机器能恪尽职守地将他们送到要去的地方。但少部分既爱幻想又没安全感的可怜虫会觉得，将他们关进一个封闭空间并任由机械主宰是很危险的。他们对视野外的世界抱有恐惧，即使已有九百九十九次被电梯送往正确的楼层，他们还是害怕在第一千次乘梯时，门打开后眼前出现恐怖的场景。
其中某个可怜虫的幻想真的实现了，当他面前的电梯门打开时，灯光闪烁，诡异的响动不停，陌生的黑色水流漫进电梯——这就是「层级增生」初次被发现的情状。好在这位可怜虫本就从事异象相关工作，没有被突如其来的异常事态吓得背过气去，所以他现在还能坐在这，为这个有求必应的异象编写档案。

【异象特性】
·一种在三层以上楼房、视野封闭的电梯中可能产生的异象。在透明观光梯等能够由内部观察到外界情况的电梯中，不会出现此异象。
·具体表现为电梯失控，无法抵达原有楼层，并高概率连接到随机的异象空间。另外，偶尔在电梯中会凭空出现播报或音乐。
·其性质近似于一种奇妙的电梯故障，将随机的电梯强制连接到了奇怪的楼层，而同楼房的楼梯则不受任何影响。
·破坏掉故障电梯并更换一架新的电梯，可使该现象消失。
·瓦解所连接的异象空间能使电梯提前自动修复，这意味着需要解决的并非电梯而是电梯外面的其他异象。

【异象奇点】
坚持不使用故障电梯而选择走楼梯至少一年（具体所需时间有波动），电梯会自愈般修复成普通电梯。

【风险评估】
危险性根据电梯所连接到的异象空间波动，上下限差距极大。对于普通人和没有充足准备的异象猎人，最大的建议是——在电梯修好之前走楼梯，就当锻炼身体又怎么样呢？

/

【收容措施】
/

【衍生异象】

Desc.LocalizedString:
Anomaly Story
Picture this: a group of expressionless people ascending or descending through the open air. Sounds creepy and funny at the same time, right? But that's exactly what's happening in every elevator out there.
The earliest elevators weren't so enclosed. You could see the gaps between floors from inside them. Only later, for safety or whatever reason, did elevators become fully sealed. The doors open, people walk in, doors close, and when they open again, the world outside has become completely different. For those inside, once the doors close, the outside world becomes a complete unknown.
Most people trust elevators, believing this machine will dutifully deliver them to their destination. A pitiful few, both imaginative and insecure, feel it's dangerous to be locked in an enclosed space and left at the mercy of machinery, fearing the unknown that lies beyond their line of sight. Even after being delivered to the correct floor nine hundred and ninety-nine times, they still fear that on the thousandth ride, when the doors open, they'll be greeted by a terrifying scene…
One such poor wretch's imagination actually came true. When the elevator doors opened before him, lights flickered, eerie sounds persisted, and unfamiliar dark water flowed into the elevator. This was how Level Proliferation was first discovered. Fortunately, this poor wretch already worked in Anomaly-related fields and didn't pass out from the sudden abnormality, so he can still sit here now, writing the profile for this obliging Anomaly.

Anomaly Characteristics
· An Anomaly that may occur in elevators with enclosed views in buildings of three floors or higher. This Anomaly will not appear in elevators where the outside can be observed from inside, such as transparent sightseeing elevators.
· Manifests as an elevator malfunction where the elevator cannot reach its original floors and has a high probability of connecting to random Anomalous Realms. Additionally, announcements or music occasionally appear out of nowhere inside the elevator.
· Its nature resembles a peculiar elevator malfunction that forcibly connects random elevators to strange floors, while stairs in the same building are completely unaffected.
· Destroying the malfunctioning elevator and replacing it with a new one will eliminate this phenomenon.
· Dismantling the connected Anomalous Realm will cause the elevator to automatically repair itself ahead of schedule, meaning the problem to solve is not the elevator itself, but the other anomalies outside it.

Anomaly Nexus
Insist on not using the malfunctioning elevator and taking the stairs for at least one year (exact required varies). The elevator will repair itself back to a normal elevator as if healing on its own.

Risk Assessment
Hazard level fluctuates depending on the Anomalous Realm the elevator connects to, with an extreme range between upper and lower limits. For ordinary people and Anomaly Hunters without sufficient preparation, the best advice is: just take the stairs until the elevator is fixed. Think of it as exercise, what's wrong with that?

Containment/Guarantee Status
/

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
